WITH SatExcellence AS (
  SELECT cds AS CDSCode, CAST(NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / NumTstTakr AS school_sat_excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
), EligibleSchools AS (
  SELECT f.CDSCode, f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)"
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN SatExcellence se ON f.CDSCode = se.CDSCode
  WHERE se.school_sat_excellence_rate > 0.3
)
SELECT MAX("Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM EligibleSchools

WITH CharterSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE CharterNum = '756'
    AND MailCity = 'San Diego'
), SATCounts AS (
  SELECT cs.CDSCode, COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0) AS test_takers
  FROM CharterSchools cs
  LEFT JOIN satscores s ON cs.CDSCode = s.cds
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(test_takers), 2) AS avg_sat_takers_per_school
FROM SATCounts;

WITH district_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    CDSCode AS cds,
    School AS school_name,
    NCESDist,
    GSserved
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND School IS NOT NULL
),

sat_takers AS (
  SELECT 
    cds,
    SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_takers
  FROM satscores 
  WHERE rtype = 'SCH'  
  GROUP BY cds
),

joined AS (
  SELECT ds.cds, ds.school_name, ds.GSserved, COALESCE(st.total_takers, 0) AS total_takers
  FROM district_schools ds
  LEFT JOIN sat_takers st ON ds.cds = st.cds
),

hs_no_takers AS (
  SELECT cds, school_name, GSserved
  FROM joined
  WHERE total_takers = 0
    AND GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),

grades_rank AS (
  SELECT school_name, GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'preschool%' THEN 0
      WHEN GSserved LIKE 'kinder%' THEN 1
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '1-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-1' THEN 2
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '2-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-2' THEN 3
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '3-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-3' THEN 4
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '4-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-4' THEN 5
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '5-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-5' THEN 6
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '6-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-6' THEN 7
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '7-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-7' THEN 8
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '8-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-8' THEN 9
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '9-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-9' THEN 10
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '10-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-10' THEN 11
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '11-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-11' THEN 12
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '12-%' OR GSserved LIKE '%-12' THEN 13
      ELSE 100
    END AS earliest_grade_num
  FROM hs_no_takers
)

SELECT school_name, GSserved AS grade_span_served
FROM grades_rank
WHERE earliest_grade_num = (SELECT MIN(earliest_grade_num) FROM grades_rank)
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH DirectlyFundedSchool AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1611190130609' AND FundingType = 'Direct'
)
SELECT
  0 AS average_sat_math_score,
  0 AS number_of_sat_takers
FROM DirectlyFundedSchool
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_school AS (
    SELECT cds, NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cds = '7618040730051'
),
county_schools AS (
    SELECT cds, NumTstTakr
    FROM satscores
    WHERE substr(cds, 1, 3) = '761'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_with_more_takers
FROM county_schools
WHERE NumTstTakr > (SELECT NumTstTakr FROM target_school);

WITH TotalSATScores AS (
  SELECT
    sc.CDSCode as cds,
    sc.District as district_type,
    sc.MailCity as mailing_city,
    (ss.AvgScrRead + ss.AvgScrMath + ss.AvgScrWrite) AS total_sat_score
  FROM schools sc
  JOIN satscores ss ON sc.CDSCode = ss.cds
  WHERE sc.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
    AND sc.FundingType = 'Public'
    AND sc.District IN ('Unified School District', 'High School District', 'Elementary School District', 'County Office of Education (COE)')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM TotalSATScores
WHERE total_sat_score >= 1500;
SELECT 0.00 AS avg_enrolled_eligible_students;

WITH StateBoardSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, AdmEmail1
  FROM schools
  WHERE DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
),
HighScorers AS (
  SELECT cds AS CDSCode, SUM(NumGE1500) AS total_high_score
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
Joined AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.AdmEmail1, h.total_high_score
  FROM StateBoardSchools s
  JOIN HighScorers h ON s.CDSCode = h.CDSCode
),
MaxCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_high_score) AS max_score FROM Joined
)
SELECT School, AdmEmail1
FROM Joined
WHERE total_high_score = (SELECT max_score FROM MaxCount)

WITH LA_2007_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode as cds
  FROM schools
  WHERE OpenDate BETWEEN '2007-01-01' AND '2007-12-31'
    AND County = 'Los Angeles'
    AND District IS NOT NULL
), SAT_per_school AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) as total_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
Joined AS (
  SELECT l.cds, COALESCE(s.total_takers, 0) AS test_takers
  FROM LA_2007_schools l
  LEFT JOIN SAT_per_school s ON l.cds = s.cds
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(test_takers), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers
FROM Joined;

WITH ClosedSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, District, County, School
  FROM schools
  WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
), SchoolSATWriting AS (
  SELECT cds, AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cds
), ClosedSchoolScores AS (
  SELECT cs.School, cs.District, cs.County, sw.avg_writing_score
  FROM ClosedSchools cs
  JOIN SchoolSATWriting sw ON cs.CDSCode = sw.cds
), MaxScore AS (
  SELECT MAX(avg_writing_score) AS max_score
  FROM ClosedSchoolScores
), SecondMaxScore AS (
  SELECT MAX(avg_writing_score) AS second_max_score
  FROM ClosedSchoolScores
  WHERE avg_writing_score < (SELECT max_score FROM MaxScore)
)
SELECT School, District, County, avg_writing_score
FROM ClosedSchoolScores
WHERE avg_writing_score = (SELECT second_max_score FROM SecondMaxScore);

WITH ActiveHighSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
    AND GSoffered = 'High School'
    AND State = 'CA'
),
SATTakersPerSchool AS (
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools_with_zero_sats
FROM ActiveHighSchools AHS
LEFT JOIN SATTakersPerSchool S ON AHS.CDSCode = S.cds
WHERE COALESCE(S.total_test_takers, 0) = 0;

WITH FremontCounty AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT "County Name"
  FROM frpm
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
),
FilteredSchools AS (
  SELECT f.CDSCode, f."County Name", f."Enrollment (K-12)", f."Free Meal Count (K-12)", f."FRPM Count (K-12)", f."Charter School (Y/N)",
    ROUND((f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100, 2) AS free_pct,
    ROUND((f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") * 100, 2) AS frpm_pct
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN FremontCounty fc ON f."County Name" = fc."County Name"
  WHERE f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
    AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL
    AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" IN (0, 1)
),
SATSum AS (
  SELECT cds, (COALESCE(AvgScrRead, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrMath, 0) + COALESCE(AvgScrWrite, 0)) AS sat_sum
  FROM satscores
),
WithSAT AS (
  SELECT fs.*, ss.sat_sum
  FROM FilteredSchools fs
  LEFT JOIN SATSum ss ON fs.CDSCode = ss.cds
),
Aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    "County Name",
    COUNT(*) AS school_count,
    ROUND(AVG(free_pct), 2) AS avg_free_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(frpm_pct), 2) AS avg_frpm_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sat_sum > 0 THEN sat_sum END), 2) AS avg_sat_score
  FROM WithSAT
  GROUP BY "County Name"
)
SELECT
  "County Name" AS county_name,
  school_count,
  avg_free_pct,
  avg_frpm_pct,
  charter_count,
  non_charter_count,
  avg_sat_score
FROM Aggregates
LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly_openings AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y-%m', OpenDate) AS year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS schools_opened
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'San Diego'
    AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
    AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01'
    AND District IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY year_month
), months_1980 AS (
  SELECT '1980-01' AS month UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-02' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-03' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-04' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-05' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-06' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-07' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-08' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-09' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-10' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-11' UNION ALL
  SELECT '1980-12'
)
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(schools_opened, 0)) AS avg_schools_per_month
FROM months_1980
LEFT JOIN monthly_openings
ON months_1980.month = monthly_openings.year_month
;

WITH CA_Schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA'
),
Math_Above_400 AS (
  SELECT cds
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrMath > 400
),
Virtual_Schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual IN ('F', 'P')
)

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT vs.CDSCode) / COUNT(DISTINCT ms.cds),
  1
) AS pct_virtual
FROM CA_Schools cs
JOIN Math_Above_400 ms ON cs.CDSCode = ms.cds
LEFT JOIN Virtual_Schools vs ON cs.CDSCode = vs.CDSCode
WHERE ms.cds IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1000

SELECT
  s.School AS name,
  s.County AS county,
  s.District AS district,
  s.City AS city,
  f.[Enrollment (K-12)] AS k12_enrollment,
  f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_count,
  f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)] AS frpm_percent,
  sa.NumTstTakr AS num_test_takers,
  sa.AvgScrRead AS avg_reading_score,
  sa.AvgScrMath AS avg_math_score,
  sa.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score,
  sa.NumGE1500 AS num_test_takers_1500plus
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01612590137943'
LIMIT 1000

WITH
  school_free_meal AS (
    SELECT
      sch.CDSCode AS school_id,
      sch.School AS school_name,
      sch.GSserved,
      CASE 
        WHEN sch.Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
        WHEN sch.Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
      END AS charter_status,
      IFNULL(SUM(frpm.[Free Meal Count (K-12)]), 0) AS total_free_meal,
      IFNULL(SUM(frpm.[Enrollment (K-12)]), 0) AS total_enrollment
    FROM
      schools sch
      LEFT JOIN frpm ON sch.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
    WHERE
      sch.County = 'Alameda'
    GROUP BY
      sch.CDSCode, sch.School, sch.GSserved, sch.Charter
  ),
  filtered_schools AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM school_free_meal
    WHERE GSserved LIKE '%12%'
  ),
  free_meal_rates AS (
    SELECT
      school_id,
      school_name,
      GSserved,
      charter_status,
      CASE WHEN total_enrollment > 0 THEN CAST(total_free_meal AS FLOAT) / total_enrollment ELSE 0 END AS free_meal_rate
    FROM
      filtered_schools
  ),
  max_rate AS (
    SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) AS max_free_meal_rate FROM free_meal_rates
  ),
  schools_with_max_rate AS (
    SELECT
      fmr.school_id,
      fmr.school_name,
      fmr.GSserved,
      fmr.charter_status,
      fmr.free_meal_rate
    FROM
      free_meal_rates fmr,
      max_rate
    WHERE
      fmr.free_meal_rate = max_rate.max_free_meal_rate
  ),
  sat_scores AS (
    SELECT
      cds AS school_id,
      (AVG(AvgScrRead) + AVG(AvgScrMath) + AVG(AvgScrWrite)) AS avg_total_sat
    FROM
      satscores
    GROUP BY
      cds
  ),
  sat_levels AS (
    SELECT
      ss.school_id,
      CASE 
        WHEN ss.avg_total_sat IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
        WHEN ss.avg_total_sat < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN ss.avg_total_sat BETWEEN 1200 AND 1500 THEN 'Average'
        WHEN ss.avg_total_sat > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
      END AS sat_performance_level
    FROM sat_scores ss
  )

SELECT
  swmr.school_name,
  ROUND(swmr.free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
  swmr.charter_status AS charter_school,
  swmr.GSserved AS grades_served,
  COALESCE(sl.sat_performance_level, 'No SAT Data') AS sat_performance_level
FROM
  schools_with_max_rate swmr
  LEFT JOIN sat_levels sl ON swmr.school_id = sl.school_id
ORDER BY swmr.school_name;

WITH VirtualSchools AS (
  SELECT County, CDSCode, School
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual = 'F'
),
CountyCounts AS (
  SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS VirtualSchoolCount
  FROM VirtualSchools
  GROUP BY County
),
RankedCounties AS (
  SELECT County, VirtualSchoolCount,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY VirtualSchoolCount DESC) AS Rnk
  FROM CountyCounts
),
TopCounties AS (
  SELECT County, VirtualSchoolCount
  FROM RankedCounties
  WHERE VirtualSchoolCount >= (SELECT VirtualSchoolCount FROM RankedCounties WHERE Rnk = 5 LIMIT 1)
),
CountyMaxReadScores AS (
  SELECT vs.County, MAX(ss.AvgScrRead) AS MaxReadScore
  FROM VirtualSchools vs
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON vs.CDSCode = ss.cds
  WHERE vs.County IN (SELECT County FROM TopCounties)
  GROUP BY vs.County
),
TopSchools AS (
  SELECT vs.County, vs.School, COALESCE(ss.AvgScrRead, -1) AS AvgRead
  FROM VirtualSchools vs
  LEFT JOIN satscores ss ON vs.CDSCode = ss.cds
  JOIN CountyMaxReadScores cmr ON vs.County = cmr.County
  WHERE ((ss.AvgScrRead = cmr.MaxReadScore AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL) OR (cmr.MaxReadScore IS NULL AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NULL))
),
CountiesWithNoReadings AS (
  SELECT County
  FROM TopCounties
  WHERE County NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT County FROM satscores WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL)
),
FinalResults AS (
  SELECT tc.County, tc.VirtualSchoolCount, ts.School
  FROM TopCounties tc
  LEFT JOIN TopSchools ts ON tc.County = ts.County
  WHERE ts.School IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT cnr.County, tc.VirtualSchoolCount, 'None' AS School
  FROM CountiesWithNoReadings cnr
  JOIN TopCounties tc ON cnr.County = tc.County
)
SELECT County, VirtualSchoolCount, School
FROM FinalResults
ORDER BY VirtualSchoolCount DESC, County, School
LIMIT 1000

WITH TargetCounty AS (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '1100170109835'
    LIMIT 1
),
ExclusiveVirtualSchools AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS count_virtual
    FROM schools
    WHERE Virtual = 'F'
      AND County IN ((SELECT County FROM TargetCounty), 'Santa Barbara')
    GROUP BY County
)
SELECT County, count_virtual
FROM ExclusiveVirtualSchools
ORDER BY count_virtual DESC, County ASC;

SELECT
  frpm."School Name" AS name,
  schools.Street || ' ' || schools.StreetAbr AS street_address
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm."School Code" = schools.CDSCode
GROUP BY frpm."School Name", street_address
HAVING
  SUM(frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") - SUM(frpm."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30
  AND MAX(CASE 
    WHEN frpm."High Grade" = 'K' THEN 8
    ELSE CAST(frpm."High Grade" AS INTEGER)
  END) <= 8;

WITH target_county AS (
  SELECT County FROM schools WHERE CDSCode = '01611430131177'
), sat_per_school AS (
  SELECT sc.CDSCode, COALESCE(sa.NumGE1500, 0) AS high_scorers
  FROM schools sc
  LEFT JOIN satscores sa ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds AND sa.rtype = 'school'
  WHERE sc.County = (SELECT County FROM target_county)
)
SELECT sc.AdmFName1 AS first_name, sc.AdmLName1 AS last_name
FROM schools sc
JOIN sat_per_school ss ON sc.CDSCode = ss.CDSCode
ORDER BY ss.high_scorers DESC, sc.CDSCode ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH SchoolSATStats AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_students,
        SUM(NumGE1500) AS excellence_count
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
    HAVING total_students >= 700
),
SchoolExcellenceRates AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        CAST(excellence_count AS FLOAT) / total_students AS excellence_rate
    FROM SchoolSATStats
),
LowestExcellence AS (
    SELECT 
        cds,
        excellence_rate
    FROM SchoolExcellenceRates
    WHERE excellence_rate = (SELECT MIN(excellence_rate) FROM SchoolExcellenceRates)
    ORDER BY cds
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    s.State
FROM schools s
JOIN LowestExcellence le ON s.CDSCode = le.cds;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS Provision2_Magnet_Schools
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
AND f.[NSLP Provision Status] = 'Provision 2'
GROUP BY s.City
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

WITH PublicHighSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School AS school_name, Street, City, State, Zip
  FROM schools
  WHERE State = 'CA' AND County = 'Los Angeles' AND School LIKE '%High School%'
), HighSchoolMealRecipients AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, SUM([FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)]) AS total_frpm_5_17
  FROM frpm
  WHERE [County Name] = 'Los Angeles'
  GROUP BY CDSCode
  HAVING total_frpm_5_17 > 500
)
SELECT phs.school_name, phs.Street AS street_address, phs.City, phs.State, phs.Zip
FROM PublicHighSchools phs
JOIN HighSchoolMealRecipients hmr ON phs.CDSCode = hmr.CDSCode
ORDER BY phs.school_name;

WITH Provision2_Magnet_Schools AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.County, s.CDSCode
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s.State = 'CA' AND s.Magnet = 1
),
County_SAT_Takers AS (
    SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY cds
),
County_Totals AS (
    SELECT p.County, COALESCE(SUM(c.total_test_takers), 0) AS total_test_takers
    FROM Provision2_Magnet_Schools p
    LEFT JOIN County_SAT_Takers c ON p.CDSCode = c.cds
    GROUP BY p.County
)
SELECT County, total_test_takers
FROM County_Totals;

WITH cards_power_flag AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        power,
        CASE
            WHEN power IS NULL THEN 1
            WHEN power LIKE '%*%' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS no_or_variable_power
    FROM cards
),
rulings_with_triggered_ability AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT uuid
    FROM rulings
    WHERE LOWER(text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
),
cards_with_rulings AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.id
    FROM cards c
    JOIN rulings_with_triggered_ability r ON c.uuid = r.uuid
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cp.id) AS distinct_card_printings_count
FROM cards_power_flag cp
JOIN cards_with_rulings cwr ON cp.id = cwr.id
WHERE cp.no_or_variable_power = 1;

WITH no_power_or_variable_power AS (
  SELECT id, setCode
  FROM cards
  WHERE power IS NULL OR power LIKE '%*%'
), french_translations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'French'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ft.setCode IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2
) AS french_translation_percentage
FROM no_power_or_variable_power np
LEFT JOIN french_translations ft ON np.setCode = ft.setCode;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS black_border_power_10_plus_count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'black'
AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
AND isOnlineOnly = 1;

WITH TranslatedSetNames AS (
  SELECT 
    setCode,
    COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS distinct_translation_count
  FROM set_translations
  GROUP BY setCode
),
SetsWithFewerThanFiveTranslations AS (
  SELECT s.code AS set_code, s.totalSetSize
  FROM sets s
  LEFT JOIN TranslatedSetNames tsn ON s.code = tsn.setCode
  WHERE COALESCE(tsn.distinct_translation_count, 0) < 5
)
SELECT SUM(totalSetSize) AS total_cards
FROM SetsWithFewerThanFiveTranslations;

WITH sets_with_translation AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE translation IS NOT NULL AND translation != ''
),
set_type_info AS (
  SELECT type, code
  FROM sets
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  GROUP BY setCode
),
translated_sets_summary AS (
  SELECT
    sti.type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sti.code) AS sets_with_translation_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(cc.card_count), 0) AS cards_in_translated_sets
  FROM set_type_info sti
  LEFT JOIN sets_with_translation swt ON sti.code = swt.setCode
  LEFT JOIN card_counts cc ON sti.code = cc.setCode
  WHERE swt.setCode IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY sti.type
),
all_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT type
  FROM sets
)
SELECT
  at.type,
  COALESCE(tss.sets_with_translation_count, 0) AS sets_with_translation_count,
  COALESCE(tss.cards_in_translated_sets, 0) AS cards_in_translated_sets
FROM all_types at
LEFT JOIN translated_sets_summary tss ON at.type = tss.type
ORDER BY at.type;

WITH MishrasFactoryUUIDs AS (
  SELECT uuid FROM cards WHERE name = "Mishra's Factory"
),
LatestRulingDate AS (
  SELECT MAX(date) AS latest_date
  FROM rulings 
  WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM MishrasFactoryUUIDs)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings
WHERE uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM MishrasFactoryUUIDs) AND date = (SELECT latest_date FROM LatestRulingDate)

WITH CreatureCards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uuid, artist
  FROM cards
  WHERE ',' || types || ',' LIKE '%,Creature,%'
),
ArtistCounts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(uuid) AS creature_card_count
  FROM CreatureCards
  GROUP BY artist
),
MaxCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(creature_card_count) AS max_count
  FROM ArtistCounts
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM ArtistCounts
WHERE creature_card_count = (SELECT max_count FROM MaxCount)
ORDER BY artist;

WITH zero_cost_cards AS (
  SELECT frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
),
max_frame_version AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_version
  FROM zero_cost_cards
)
SELECT 
  c.frameVersion, 
  COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards c
JOIN max_frame_version m ON c.frameVersion = m.max_version
GROUP BY c.frameVersion;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
  SELECT frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS printing_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  GROUP BY frameVersion
), total_printings AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE name = 'Tarmogoyf'
), ranked_frames AS (
  SELECT frameVersion, printing_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY frameVersion DESC) AS rank
  FROM tarmogoyf_printings
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT frameVersion FROM ranked_frames WHERE rank = 1) AS newest_frame_version,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT printing_count FROM ranked_frames WHERE rank = 1) / (SELECT total_count FROM total_printings), 2) AS percentage_of_printings
;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cards.name) AS zero_cost_commander_legal_cards
FROM cards
JOIN legalities ON cards.uuid = legalities.uuid
WHERE cards.manaCost = '{0}'
AND legalities.format = 'Commander'
AND legalities.status = 'Legal';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_cards_with_flying_and_cycling
FROM cards
WHERE keywords LIKE '%Flying%'
  AND keywords LIKE '%Cycling%'

WITH abyssal_sets AS (
    SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
    FROM sets s
    JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
    WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
first_abyssal_set AS (
    SELECT code, name, releaseDate
    FROM abyssal_sets
    ORDER BY releaseDate ASC, code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_recent_set AS (
    SELECT code, name, releaseDate
    FROM sets
    ORDER BY releaseDate DESC, code ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
selected_sets AS (
    SELECT * FROM first_abyssal_set
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM most_recent_set
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        setCode,
        COUNT(*) AS total_cards,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN manaCost IS NOT NULL AND convertedManaCost <= 3 THEN 1 END) AS cheap_cards
    FROM cards
    GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT 
    s.name AS set_name,
    ROUND(100.0 * cc.cheap_cards / cc.total_cards, 2) AS pct_cheap_cards
FROM selected_sets s
JOIN card_counts cc ON cc.setCode = s.code
LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS release_promotion_card_count
FROM cards
WHERE promoTypes LIKE '%release%' AND promoTypes NOT LIKE '%prerelease%'

WITH AbzanCards AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.number, c.setCode
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.watermark = 'Abzan'
),
MaxCollector AS (
  SELECT setCode, MAX(CAST(number AS INTEGER)) AS max_collector_number
  FROM AbzanCards
  GROUP BY setCode
),
AbzanMaxCards AS (
  SELECT a.name, a.number, a.setCode
  FROM AbzanCards a
  JOIN MaxCollector m ON a.setCode = m.setCode AND CAST(a.number AS INTEGER) = m.max_collector_number
),
ForeignPrintingsCount AS (
  SELECT f.name, COUNT(*) AS foreign_printing_count
  FROM foreign_data f
  GROUP BY f.name
)
SELECT a.name, a.number AS collector_number, COALESCE(fp.foreign_printing_count, 0) AS foreign_printing_count
FROM AbzanMaxCards a
LEFT JOIN ForeignPrintingsCount fp ON a.name = fp.name
ORDER BY a.name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_white_bordered_cards_power_less_3
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND power != '*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) < 3;

WITH DarkAscensionFlash AS (
  SELECT name, convertedManaCost
  FROM cards
  WHERE setCode = 'DKA' AND keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
)
SELECT name
FROM DarkAscensionFlash
WHERE convertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(convertedManaCost) FROM DarkAscensionFlash)
ORDER BY name;

WITH filtered_sets AS (
  SELECT code, name, keyruneCode
  FROM sets
  WHERE strftime('%Y', releaseDate) = '2020'
), language_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT language) AS language_count
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM filtered_sets)
  GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT f.name, f.keyruneCode AS keyrune_code, IFNULL(l.language_count, 0) AS language_count
FROM filtered_sets f
LEFT JOIN language_counts l ON f.code = l.setCode
ORDER BY f.name;

WITH localized_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code
  FROM sets s
  JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  WHERE s.releaseDate BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
    AND st.language != 'English'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards c
WHERE c.setCode IN (SELECT code FROM localized_sets);

WITH ArenaBlackBorderHighPower AS (
  SELECT c.artist
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.borderColor = 'black'
    AND c.power IS NOT NULL
    AND c.power REGEXP '^-?\\d+$'
    AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10
    AND c.availability LIKE '%arena%'
), ArtistCounts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM ArenaBlackBorderHighPower
  GROUP BY artist
), MaxCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(card_count) AS max_count
  FROM ArtistCounts
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM ArtistCounts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT max_count FROM MaxCount);

WITH sensitive_paper_cards AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.name
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.hasContentWarning = 1
    AND (c.hasNonFoil = 1 OR c.hasFoil = 1)
    AND c.isOnlineOnly = 0
    AND c.mtgoId IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_sensitive_paper_only_cards
FROM sensitive_paper_cards;

WITH japanese_named_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'Japanese' AND translation IS NOT NULL
), expansion_types AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets
), japanese_name_counts AS (
  SELECT sets.type AS expansion_type, COUNT(DISTINCT sets.code) AS japanese_name_count
  FROM sets
  JOIN japanese_named_sets ON sets.code = japanese_named_sets.setCode
  GROUP BY sets.type
)
SELECT et.type AS expansion_type, COALESCE(jnc.japanese_name_count, 0) AS japanese_name_count
FROM expansion_types et
LEFT JOIN japanese_name_counts jnc ON et.type = jnc.expansion_type
ORDER BY et.type ASC;

WITH arena_only_big_creatures AS (
  SELECT artist
  FROM cards
  WHERE power IS NOT NULL
    AND power NOT LIKE '%*%'
    AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 5
    AND borderColor = 'black'
    AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
    AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist) AS artist_count
FROM arena_only_big_creatures;

WITH ancestor_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.setCode
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
), latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(s.releaseDate) AS max_release_date
  FROM sets s
  JOIN ancestor_sets a ON s.code = a.setCode
), latest_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code
  FROM sets s
  JOIN ancestor_sets a ON s.code = a.setCode
  WHERE s.releaseDate = (SELECT max_release_date FROM latest_date)
), creatures_with_power_gt_toughness AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_cards
  FROM cards
  WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM latest_sets)
    AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) > CAST(toughness AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT count_cards
FROM creatures_with_power_gt_toughness;

WITH commander_leadable AS (
  SELECT name, frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE leadershipSkills LIKE '%Commander%'
),
foil_regular_cards AS (
  SELECT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE hasFoil = 1
  INTERSECT
  SELECT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE hasNonFoil = 1
),
eligible_cards AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.frameVersion
  FROM commander_leadable c
  JOIN foil_regular_cards f ON c.name = f.name
)
SELECT frameVersion AS frame_year, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM eligible_cards
GROUP BY frameVersion
ORDER BY frameVersion DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rulings_for_fireball
FROM rulings
JOIN cards ON rulings.uuid = cards.uuid
WHERE cards.name = 'Fireball';

WITH card_foils AS (
  SELECT id, artist, frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
    AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
    AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
), max_frame_version AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_version
  FROM card_foils
)
SELECT cf.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS count_cards
FROM card_foils cf
JOIN max_frame_version mfv ON cf.frameVersion = mfv.max_version
GROUP BY cf.frameVersion;

WITH erica_cards AS (
  SELECT uuid, name, number, setCode
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist = 'Erica Yang'
), legal_printings AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.number, c.setCode
  FROM erica_cards c
  JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid
  WHERE l.format = 'pauper' AND l.status = 'Legal'
), physical_sets AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE isOnlineOnly = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_of_printings
FROM legal_printings lp
JOIN physical_sets ps ON lp.setCode = ps.code;

WITH stocked_cards AS (
  SELECT
    cardKingdomFoilId,
    cardKingdomId
  FROM cards
  WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
    AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
    AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
)
SELECT cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM stocked_cards
ORDER BY cardKingdomFoilId ASC, cardKingdomId ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH Boros_Foreign_Cards AS (
  SELECT type
  FROM cards
  WHERE watermark = 'boros'
    AND printings NOT LIKE '%en%'
), Counted_Types AS (
  SELECT type, COUNT(*) as type_count
  FROM Boros_Foreign_Cards
  GROUP BY type
), Max_Count AS (
  SELECT MAX(type_count) AS max_count
  FROM Counted_Types
)
SELECT type, type_count
FROM Counted_Types
WHERE type_count = (SELECT max_count FROM Max_Count)
ORDER BY type;

WITH ravnica_guilds AS (
  SELECT 'Azorius' AS guild UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Boros' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Dimir' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Golgari' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Gruul' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Izzet' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Orzhov' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Rakdos' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Selesnya' UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Simic'
),
cards_ravnica AS (
  SELECT id, watermark, multiverseId
  FROM cards
  WHERE watermark IN (SELECT guild FROM ravnica_guilds) AND multiverseId IS NOT NULL
),
foreign_non_eng AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT multiverseid
  FROM foreign_data
  WHERE language != 'English' AND multiverseid IS NOT NULL
),
filtered_cards AS (
  SELECT c.watermark AS guild, c.id
  FROM cards_ravnica c
  WHERE c.multiverseId IN (SELECT multiverseid FROM foreign_non_eng)
),
counts AS (
  SELECT guild, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS count_cards
  FROM filtered_cards
  GROUP BY guild
),
max_result AS (
  SELECT MAX(count_cards) AS max_count
  FROM counts
)
SELECT c.guild, c.count_cards
FROM counts c, max_result m
WHERE c.count_cards = m.max_count
ORDER BY c.guild
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS card_with_textbox_count
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion >= '2015'
  AND isTextless = 0;

WITH LatestFrameVersion AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_frame_version FROM cards
),
PromotionalMultiFaceCards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT name
  FROM cards
  WHERE frameVersion = (SELECT max_frame_version FROM LatestFrameVersion)
    AND isPromo = 1
    AND layout IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT layout FROM cards WHERE layout IN ('modal_dfc', 'transform', 'meld', 'aftermath', 'flip', 'double_faced_token')
    )
)
SELECT name FROM PromotionalMultiFaceCards
ORDER BY name;

WITH tarmogoyf_printings AS (
  SELECT c.setCode, s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate, CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) AS frame_year
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE LOWER(c.name) = 'tarmogoyf'
), qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT set_name, releaseDate
  FROM tarmogoyf_printings
  WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS INTEGER) - frame_year >= 10
    AND frame_year <= CAST(strftime('%Y', releaseDate) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT DISTINCT set_name, releaseDate
FROM qualifying_sets
ORDER BY releaseDate;

WITH counterspell_cards AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, c.setCode, c.number, c.multiverseId
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
),
languages AS (
  SELECT fd.uuid, fd.language
  FROM foreign_data fd
  WHERE fd.language IN ('French', 'Italian')
),
lang_count AS (
  SELECT cc.setCode, cc.number, COUNT(DISTINCT l.language) AS lang_count
  FROM counterspell_cards cc
  JOIN languages l ON cc.uuid = l.uuid
  GROUP BY cc.setCode, cc.number
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM lang_count
WHERE lang_count = 2;

WITH from_the_vault_type AS (
  SELECT type
  FROM sets
  WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
),
sets_same_type AS (
  SELECT code, name, releaseDate
  FROM sets, from_the_vault_type
  WHERE sets.type = from_the_vault_type.type
),
sets_with_foreign_name AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE translation IS NOT NULL AND translation != ''
)
SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets_same_type s
LEFT JOIN sets_with_foreign_name f ON s.code = f.setCode
WHERE f.setCode IS NULL
ORDER BY s.releaseDate ASC;

WITH printing_details AS (
  SELECT c.setCode, c.name, s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate, c.frameVersion
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
),
max_frame_version AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS max_frame FROM printing_details
),
newest_printings AS (
  SELECT * FROM printing_details WHERE frameVersion = (SELECT max_frame FROM max_frame_version)
),
max_release_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(releaseDate) AS max_release FROM newest_printings
)
SELECT DISTINCT set_name, releaseDate
FROM newest_printings
WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT max_release FROM max_release_date)
ORDER BY set_name
LIMIT 1000;

WITH sets_2020 AS (
  SELECT code, releaseDate FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate >= '2020-01-01' AND releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
), spanish_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT setCode FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'es'
)
SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets_2020 s
LEFT JOIN spanish_sets st ON s.code = st.setCode
WHERE st.setCode IS NULL
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

WITH sets_2016 AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate >= '2016-01-01' AND releaseDate <= '2016-12-31'
),
translations_counts AS (
  SELECT s.code, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS num_languages
  FROM sets_2016 s
  LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode
  GROUP BY s.code
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(num_languages), 2) AS avg_languages
FROM translations_counts;

WITH BorosCards AS (
  SELECT
    c.uuid,
    c.type AS english_card_type,
    fd.name AS jp_name
  FROM cards c
  JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
    AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
RulingsCount AS (
  SELECT
    uuid,
    COUNT(*) AS rulings_total
  FROM rulings
  GROUP BY uuid
),
GroupedCards AS (
  SELECT
    jp_name,
    english_card_type,
    uuid
  FROM BorosCards
)
SELECT
  jp_name,
  english_card_type,
  COALESCE(SUM(r.rulings_total), 0) AS total_rulings
FROM GroupedCards g
LEFT JOIN RulingsCount r ON g.uuid = r.uuid
GROUP BY jp_name, english_card_type
ORDER BY jp_name, english_card_type

WITH FlavorTextTranslations AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fd.language, c.id AS card_id
  FROM foreign_data fd
  JOIN cards c ON fd.name = c.name AND fd.multiverseid = CAST(c.multiverseId AS INTEGER)
  WHERE fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL AND length(fd.flavorText) > 0
),
SetTranslationsLang AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT language
  FROM set_translations
),
FlavorTranslationsCount AS (
  SELECT st.language, COUNT(DISTINCT ft.card_id) AS translated_printings
  FROM SetTranslationsLang st
  LEFT JOIN FlavorTextTranslations ft ON st.language = ft.language
  GROUP BY st.language
),
MinCount AS (
  SELECT MIN(translated_printings) AS min_translated
  FROM FlavorTranslationsCount
)
SELECT language, translated_printings
FROM FlavorTranslationsCount, MinCount
WHERE translated_printings = min_translated
ORDER BY language ASC;

WITH French_named_sets AS (
  SELECT setCode
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE language = 'fr' AND translation IS NOT NULL AND translation != ''
),
Creatures_power_10_plus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.name
  FROM cards c
  WHERE c.power IS NOT NULL
    AND c.power != '*'
    AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10
),
Creatures_in_french_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.name
  FROM cards c
  JOIN French_named_sets f ON c.setCode = f.setCode
  WHERE c.name IN (SELECT name FROM Creatures_power_10_plus)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS number_of_creatures
FROM Creatures_in_french_sets;

WITH mtgo_sets AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM sets
  WHERE mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
), printings_2014 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cards
  WHERE strftime('%Y', originalReleaseDate) = '2014'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM printings_2014 p
JOIN mtgo_sets s ON p.setCode = s.code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS italian_rules_printing_count
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL
  AND f.text != '';

WITH commander_2020_sets AS (
  SELECT id, name, code
  FROM sets
  WHERE type = 'commander'
    AND releaseDate BETWEEN '2020-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode AS set_code, COUNT(*) AS total_cards
  FROM cards
  WHERE setCode IN (SELECT code FROM commander_2020_sets)
    AND isOnlineOnly = 0
  GROUP BY setCode
),
language_counts AS (
  SELECT fd.language, c.setCode
  FROM foreign_data fd
  JOIN cards c ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.setCode IN (SELECT code FROM commander_2020_sets)
  GROUP BY c.setCode, fd.language
),
language_count_summary AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(language) AS language_count
  FROM language_counts
  GROUP BY setCode
),
total_data AS (
  SELECT c.set_code, s.name, c.total_cards, COALESCE(l.language_count, 0) AS language_count
  FROM card_counts c
  JOIN commander_2020_sets s ON c.set_code = s.code
  LEFT JOIN language_count_summary l ON c.set_code = l.setCode
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_cards) AS max_cards
  FROM total_data
)
SELECT set_code AS id, name, language_count
FROM total_data
WHERE total_cards = (SELECT max_cards FROM max_count)
ORDER BY set_code ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH swamp_foreign_languages AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.language
  FROM cards c
  JOIN foreign_data f ON c.uuid = f.uuid
  WHERE c.name = 'Swamp'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS foreign_language_count
FROM swamp_foreign_languages;

WITH UK_posters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.id
  FROM users u
  JOIN posts p ON u.id = p.ownerUserId
  WHERE u.location = 'United Kingdom'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.reputation), 0) AS total_reputation
FROM users u
WHERE u.id IN (SELECT id FROM UK_posters)

WITH CommentersWithLink AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT UserId
  FROM comments
  WHERE Text LIKE '%http://%'
),
UserAge AS (
  SELECT AVG(age) AS average_age
  FROM users
  WHERE Id IN (SELECT UserId FROM CommentersWithLink)
)
SELECT ROUND(average_age, 2) AS average_age_with_link FROM UserAge;

WITH organizer_badge AS (
  SELECT Id FROM badges WHERE Name = 'Organizer'
), german_organizers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.UserId
  FROM badges b
  JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' AND b.Name = 'Organizer'
), first_organizer_dates AS (
  SELECT UserId, MIN(Date) AS FirstOrganizerDate
  FROM badges
  WHERE Name = 'Organizer'
  GROUP BY UserId
), badge_counts_before AS (
  SELECT b.UserId, COUNT(*) AS BadgesBeforeCount
  FROM badges b
  JOIN first_organizer_dates f ON b.UserId = f.UserId
  WHERE b.Date < f.FirstOrganizerDate
    AND b.Name != 'Organizer'
  GROUP BY b.UserId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SeasonedOrganizerCount
FROM german_organizers g
JOIN badge_counts_before b ON g.UserId = b.UserId
WHERE b.BadgesBeforeCount >= 5;

WITH FirstPosts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS firstPostDate
  FROM posts
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
),
Users2010India AS (
  SELECT u.Id
  FROM users u
  JOIN FirstPosts fp ON u.Id = fp.OwnerUserId
  WHERE strftime('%Y', fp.firstPostDate) = '2010'
  AND LOWER(u.Location) = 'india'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_users_india_2010_first_post
FROM Users2010India;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS avg_reputation
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Score < 20 AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'

WITH post_last_editors AS (
  SELECT p.Id AS post_id, p.Score, p.LastEditorUserId, u.location
  FROM posts p
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
  WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01' AND p.CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),

classified_posts AS (
  SELECT 
    post_id, Score, LastEditorUserId,
    CASE WHEN location LIKE '%Germany%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_germany_last_editor
  FROM post_last_editors
),

aggregated_scores AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_germany_last_editor = 1 THEN Score ELSE 0 END) AS total_score_germany_last_editor,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_germany_last_editor = 0 THEN Score ELSE 0 END) AS total_score_other_last_editor
  FROM classified_posts
),

germany_last_editors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
  FROM users u
  JOIN classified_posts cp ON cp.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
  WHERE cp.is_germany_last_editor = 1
)

SELECT
  (SELECT total_score_germany_last_editor FROM aggregated_scores) AS total_score_germany_last_editor,
  (SELECT total_score_other_last_editor FROM aggregated_scores) AS total_score_other_last_editor,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM germany_last_editors) AS germany_last_editor_user_count,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(Reputation), 0) FROM germany_last_editors) AS germany_last_editor_reputation_sum
;

SELECT SUM(u.Reputation) AS total_reputation
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<R>%'
  AND date(p.LasActivityDate) = '2014-08-27';

WITH TargetQuestion AS (
  SELECT Id
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
    AND PostTypeId = 1
  LIMIT 1
),
LinkingQuestions AS (
  SELECT pl.PostId
  FROM postLinks pl
  JOIN TargetQuestion tq ON pl.RelatedPostId = tq.Id
  JOIN posts p ON p.Id = pl.PostId
  WHERE pl.LinkTypeId = 1
    AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.Score), 0) AS TotalScore
FROM posts p
JOIN LinkingQuestions lq ON p.Id = lq.PostId;

WITH GermanUsers AS (
    SELECT Id, DisplayName
    FROM users
    WHERE Location LIKE '%Germany%'
),
UserBadgeCounts AS (
    SELECT UserId, COUNT(*) AS BadgeCount
    FROM badges
    WHERE UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM GermanUsers)
    GROUP BY UserId
),
RankedUsers AS (
    SELECT 
        UserId,
        BadgeCount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BadgeCount DESC) AS RankDesc
    FROM UserBadgeCounts
),
SecondHighest AS (
    SELECT BadgeCount
    FROM RankedUsers
    WHERE RankDesc = 2
)
SELECT u.DisplayName, r.BadgeCount
FROM RankedUsers r
JOIN GermanUsers u ON r.UserId = u.Id
WHERE r.BadgeCount = (SELECT BadgeCount FROM SecondHighest)
ORDER BY u.DisplayName;

WITH CaliforniaUsers AS (
  SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
  FROM users
  WHERE Location LIKE '%CA%'
), MaxViewCount AS (
  SELECT MAX(Views) AS MaxViews
  FROM CaliforniaUsers
)
SELECT cu.Id, cu.DisplayName, cu.Views, cu.Reputation
FROM CaliforniaUsers cu, MaxViewCount mv
WHERE cu.Views = mv.MaxViews;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) AS india_yearling_users_before_2014
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON u.id = b.userId
WHERE u.location LIKE '%India%'
  AND b.name = 'Yearling'
  AND b.date < '2014-01-01';

WITH SupporterUsers AS (
  SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName
  FROM users u
  JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
  WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter'
    AND u.Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DisplayName) AS NumDisplayNames
FROM SupporterUsers
WHERE DisplayName IS NOT NULL;

WITH related_counts AS (
  SELECT pl.postId AS post_id, COUNT(pl.relatedPostId) AS related_count
  FROM postLinks pl
  GROUP BY pl.postId
),
posts_with_phrase AS (
  SELECT id, title
  FROM posts
  WHERE title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
joined AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.title, COALESCE(rc.related_count, 0) AS related_count
  FROM posts_with_phrase p
  LEFT JOIN related_counts rc ON p.id = rc.post_id
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(related_count) AS max_related_count
  FROM joined
)
SELECT title, related_count
FROM joined, max_count
WHERE related_count = max_related_count
ORDER BY title;

WITH PostCounts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts
  WHERE strftime('%Y', CreaionDate) = '2012'
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
  HAVING post_count > 10
),
UpVotes AS (
  SELECT UserId AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS up_vote_count
  FROM votes
  WHERE VoteTypeId = 2
  GROUP BY UserId
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(u.up_vote_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_up_votes_cast,
  ROUND(AVG(u2.Age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM PostCounts p
LEFT JOIN UpVotes u ON p.user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN users u2 ON p.user_id = u2.Id
WHERE u2.Age IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1

WITH posts_and_answers AS (
  SELECT
    posts.Id AS post_id,
    strftime('%Y-%m', posts.CreaionDate) AS month,
    posts.AnswerCount AS answer_count
  FROM posts
  WHERE posts.PostTypeId = 1 AND strftime('%Y', posts.CreaionDate) = '2010'
),
posts_with_links AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT postLinks.PostId AS post_id, strftime('%Y-%m', postLinks.CreationDate) AS link_month
  FROM postLinks
  WHERE strftime('%Y', postLinks.CreationDate) = '2010'
),
posts_filtered AS (
  SELECT p.post_id, p.month
  FROM posts_and_answers p
  JOIN posts_with_links l ON p.post_id = l.post_id AND p.month = l.link_month
  WHERE p.answer_count <= 2
),
monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT month, COUNT(DISTINCT post_id) AS count
  FROM posts_filtered
  GROUP BY month
),
months_list AS (
  SELECT '2010-01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT '2010-02' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-03' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-04'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2010-05' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-06' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-07' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-08'
  UNION ALL SELECT '2010-09' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-10' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-11' UNION ALL SELECT '2010-12'
),
monthly_counts_full AS (
  SELECT m.month, COALESCE(mc.count, 0) AS count
  FROM months_list m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_counts mc ON m.month = mc.month
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(count), 2) AS avg_posts
FROM monthly_counts_full;

WITH Posts2010 AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.OwnerUserId, p.Score
  FROM posts p
  WHERE strftime('%Y', p.CreaionDate) = '2010' AND p.Score > 5
), UserReputation AS (
  SELECT u.Id, u.Reputation
  FROM users u
), 
PostsWithReputation AS (
  SELECT p.Id, p.OwnerUserId, p.Score, ur.Reputation
  FROM Posts2010 p
  LEFT JOIN UserReputation ur ON p.OwnerUserId = ur.Id
),
CountPosts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_posts,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Reputation >= 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_rep_posts
  FROM PostsWithReputation
)
SELECT ROUND(((total_posts - high_rep_posts) * 100.0) / total_posts, 2) AS percent_non_high_rep_posts
FROM CountPosts;

WITH TargetPost AS (
  SELECT Id
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
  AND PostTypeId = 1
), EditComments AS (
  SELECT ph.UserId, ph.Comment, COUNT(*) AS EditCount
  FROM postHistory ph
  JOIN TargetPost tp ON ph.PostId = tp.Id
  WHERE ph.Comment IS NOT NULL AND ph.Comment != ''
  GROUP BY ph.UserId, ph.Comment
), UserEditCounts AS (
  SELECT UserId, SUM(EditCount) AS TotalEdits
  FROM EditComments
  GROUP BY UserId
), MaxEdits AS (
  SELECT MAX(TotalEdits) AS MaxEditCount
  FROM UserEditCounts
), TopEditors AS (
  SELECT u.DisplayName, uec.TotalEdits
  FROM UserEditCounts uec
  JOIN MaxEdits me ON uec.TotalEdits = me.MaxEditCount
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = uec.UserId
)
SELECT DisplayName, TotalEdits
FROM TopEditors;

WITH customer_consumption_2012 AS (
  SELECT
    CustomerID,
    SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
active_customers_2012 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2012'
)
SELECT
  c.Segment AS clientsegment,
  COUNT(*) AS num_small_customers
FROM customers c
JOIN customer_consumption_2012 cc ON c.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
JOIN active_customers_2012 ac ON c.CustomerID = ac.CustomerID
WHERE cc.total_amount < 30000
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY num_small_customers DESC;

WITH czech_high_value_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Date || ' ' || Time) AS first_transaction,
    MAX(Date || ' ' || Time) AS last_transaction
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
  WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Price > 1000
)
SELECT CAST((strftime('%s', last_transaction) - strftime('%s', first_transaction)) / 60 AS INTEGER) AS elapsed_minutes
FROM czech_high_value_transactions;

WITH customer_months AS (
  SELECT
    t.CustomerID,
    STRFTIME('%m', t.Date) AS month,
    c.Currency
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
  WHERE t.Date >= '2013-01-01' AND t.Date < '2013-12-01'
    AND p.Description LIKE '%fuel%'
  GROUP BY t.CustomerID, month, c.Currency
),
cust_month_counts AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, Currency, COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS months_count
  FROM customer_months
  GROUP BY CustomerID, Currency
  HAVING months_count = 11
),
currency_counts AS (
  SELECT Currency, COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS num_customers
  FROM cust_month_counts
  GROUP BY Currency
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(num_customers) AS max_num FROM currency_counts
)
SELECT Currency, num_customers
FROM currency_counts
WHERE num_customers = (SELECT max_num FROM max_count)
ORDER BY Currency;

WITH yearly_spending AS (
  SELECT 
    t.CustomerID,
    c.currency,
    SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spent
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.customerid
  WHERE strftime('%Y', t.Date) = '2012'
  GROUP BY t.CustomerID, c.currency
),
avg_spending_by_currency AS (
  SELECT currency, AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent
  FROM yearly_spending
  WHERE currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
  GROUP BY currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
  (SELECT avg_spent FROM avg_spending_by_currency WHERE currency = 'CZK')
  -
  (SELECT avg_spent FROM avg_spending_by_currency WHERE currency = 'EUR')
) AS difference_in_avg_spending
;

WITH kam_customers AS (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM customers
  WHERE Segment = 'KAM' AND Currency = 'CZK'
),
fuel_consumption_2013 AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_fuel_consumption
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '2013'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS kam_czk_customers_over_1m
FROM kam_customers k
JOIN fuel_consumption_2013 f ON k.CustomerID = f.CustomerID
WHERE f.total_fuel_consumption > 1000000;

WITH feb2013_gasoline_purchases AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k t
  JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
  WHERE p.Description LIKE '%gasoline%'
    AND t.Date BETWEEN '2013-02-01' AND '2013-02-28'
), sme_customers AS (
  SELECT CustomerID
  FROM customers
  WHERE Segment = 'SME'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CustomerID) AS sme_gasoline_buyers_feb2013
FROM feb2013_gasoline_purchases f
JOIN sme_customers s ON f.CustomerID = s.CustomerID;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(Player.height), 2) AS average_height
FROM Match
JOIN Player ON Match.home_player_3 = Player.player_api_id
WHERE Player.height > 180;

WITH DefensivePlayers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE defensive_work_rate = 'high'
),
YoungPlayers AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE SUBSTR(birthday, 1, 4) >= '1991'
),
PlayersWithDefWork AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM DefensivePlayers
    WHERE player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM YoungPlayers)
  ) * 1.0 /
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM PlayersWithDefWork
    WHERE player_api_id IN (SELECT player_api_id FROM YoungPlayers)
  ), 2) AS high_defensive_work_rate_share
;

WITH LatestDefensiveWorkRate AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, defensive_work_rate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height) * 2.54, 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player p
JOIN LatestDefensiveWorkRate dwr ON p.player_api_id = dwr.player_api_id
WHERE dwr.rn = 1
AND dwr.defensive_work_rate != 'medium';

WITH RiskyTeams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
TeamsWithShortNames AS (
  SELECT team_api_id, team_short_name
  FROM Team
  WHERE team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM RiskyTeams)
),
ShortNameCounts AS (
  SELECT team_short_name, COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) AS club_count
  FROM TeamsWithShortNames
  GROUP BY team_short_name
  HAVING club_count > 1
),
RiskyTeamsOnDate AS (
  SELECT team_api_id, chanceCreationPassing
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE date = '2014-09-19'
    AND team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM TeamsWithShortNames)
),
Aggregated AS (
  SELECT s.team_short_name,
         COUNT(DISTINCT r.team_api_id) AS num_clubs,
         ROUND(AVG(r.chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS avg_passing_risk
  FROM ShortNameCounts s
  JOIN TeamsWithShortNames t ON s.team_short_name = t.team_short_name
  JOIN RiskyTeamsOnDate r ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
  GROUP BY s.team_short_name
)
SELECT team_short_name, num_clubs, avg_passing_risk
FROM Aggregated
ORDER BY avg_passing_risk DESC, team_short_name ASC;

WITH LatestDefensiveWorkRate AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        defensive_work_rate,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_api_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rk
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE defensive_work_rate = 'medium'
), FilteredPlayers AS (
    SELECT Player.player_api_id, Player.height
    FROM Player
    JOIN LatestDefensiveWorkRate ON Player.player_api_id = LatestDefensiveWorkRate.player_api_id
    WHERE rk = 1
      AND substr(Player.birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1995'
      AND Player.height IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS avg_height_cm
FROM FilteredPlayers;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.weight), 1) AS avg_weight_left_footed
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

WITH PlayerMatches AS (
  SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name
  FROM Player p
  WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Adam%' AND p.weight > 170
), SeasonMatches AS (
  SELECT m.id
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
), PlayerParticipation AS (
  SELECT pm.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS matches_played
  FROM PlayerMatches pm
  JOIN Match m ON m.id IN (SELECT id FROM SeasonMatches)
    AND (
      m.home_player_1 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_2 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_3 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_4 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_5 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_6 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_7 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_8 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_9 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_10 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.home_player_11 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_1 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_2 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_3 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_4 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_5 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_6 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_7 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_8 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_9 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_10 = pm.player_api_id OR
      m.away_player_11 = pm.player_api_id
    )
  GROUP BY pm.player_name
)
SELECT player_name, matches_played
FROM PlayerParticipation
ORDER BY player_name;

WITH HomeWins AS (
    SELECT
        id AS match_id,
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        date,
        home_team_goal - away_team_goal AS goal_diff
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_team_goal - away_team_goal >= 3
),
LatestSpeedRating AS (
    SELECT
        hw.match_id,
        ta.team_api_id,
        ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
    FROM HomeWins hw
    JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON hw.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    WHERE ta.date <= hw.date
      AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
      AND ta.date = (
          SELECT MAX(date)
          FROM Team_Attributes
          WHERE team_api_id = hw.team_api_id AND date <= hw.date
      )
),
HomeWinsWithSpeed AS (
    SELECT match_id, team_api_id FROM LatestSpeedRating
),
WinCounts AS (
    SELECT
        team_api_id,
        COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM HomeWinsWithSpeed
    GROUP BY team_api_id
),
MaxCount AS (
    SELECT MAX(win_count) AS max_win_count FROM WinCounts
)

SELECT
    t.team_long_name AS club_name,
    t.team_short_name AS club_short_name,
    wc.win_count AS big_fast_home_wins
FROM WinCounts wc
JOIN Team t ON wc.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
CROSS JOIN MaxCount mc
WHERE wc.win_count = mc.max_win_count
ORDER BY club_name;

WITH LatestRatingRecord AS (
  SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.id, pa.volleys
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  WHERE (pa.player_api_id, pa.date, pa.id) IN (
    SELECT player_api_id, date, MAX(id)
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE (player_api_id, date) IN (
      SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) FROM Player_Attributes GROUP BY player_api_id
    )
    GROUP BY player_api_id, date
  )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player p
JOIN LatestRatingRecord lrr ON p.player_api_id = lrr.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180 AND lrr.volleys > 70
LIMIT 1000;

WITH PlayerThirdPlayerGoals AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    SUM(m.home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id = m.home_player_3
  GROUP BY p.player_api_id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS avg_total_home_goals_by_third_player
FROM PlayerThirdPlayerGoals;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
  AND attacking_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium')
  AND date = '2015-01-01';

WITH LatestAttributes AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.attacking_work_rate
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) latest ON pa.player_api_id = latest.player_api_id AND pa.date = latest.max_date
    WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left'
)

SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN attacking_work_rate = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
, 1) AS low_attacking_work_rate_percentage
FROM LatestAttributes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS players_with_high_jumping_score
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2007-08-30'
  AND jumping >= 80;

WITH LastMatch AS (
    SELECT m.id, m.season, m.date
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id OR t.team_api_id = m.away_team_api_id
    WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' AND m.season = '2012/2013'
    ORDER BY m.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
SnapshotAtLastMatch AS (
    SELECT ta.id, ta.date as snapshot_date, ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
    FROM Team_Attributes ta, LastMatch lm
    WHERE ta.team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge')
      AND ta.date <= lm.date
    ORDER BY ta.date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM SnapshotAtLastMatch;

WITH target_date AS (SELECT DATE('2013-07-12') AS day),
player_latest_rating AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_api_id,
        p.player_name,
        pa.overall_rating,
        pa.date
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
), 
latest_per_player AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        MAX(date) AS max_date
    FROM player_latest_rating
    WHERE date <= (SELECT day FROM target_date)
    GROUP BY player_api_id
),
ratings_on_date AS (
    SELECT
        plr.player_api_id,
        plr.player_name,
        plr.overall_rating
    FROM player_latest_rating plr
    JOIN latest_per_player lpp ON plr.player_api_id = lpp.player_api_id AND plr.date = lpp.max_date
),
landon AS (
    SELECT overall_rating
    FROM ratings_on_date
    WHERE player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
),
avg_rating AS (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rate
    FROM ratings_on_date
)
SELECT ROUND(
    ((landon.overall_rating - avg_rating.avg_rate) / avg_rating.avg_rate) * 100,
    2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM landon, avg_rating;

WITH first_month AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS min_month
    FROM account
),
accounts_in_first_month AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
    FROM account a
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = (SELECT min_month FROM first_month)
),
max_population AS (
    SELECT MAX(A9) AS max_pop
    FROM district
    WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM accounts_in_first_month)
)
SELECT district_id, A9 AS population
FROM district
WHERE A9 = (SELECT max_pop FROM max_population)
ORDER BY district_id;

WITH male_customers AS (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'M' AND substr(birth_date, 1, 4) IN ('1974', '1975', '1976')
), male_accounts AS (
  SELECT disp.account_id
  FROM disp
  JOIN male_customers ON disp.client_id = male_customers.client_id
), target_transactions AS (
  SELECT trans.*
  FROM trans
  JOIN male_accounts ON trans.account_id = male_accounts.account_id
  WHERE (trans.type IS NULL OR trans.type = '')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_payment_purpose_transactions
FROM target_transactions;

WITH loan_duration AS (
  SELECT
    loan_id,
    amount,
    date AS approval_date,
    duration,
    account_id
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= '1995-12-31'
),
active_loans AS (
  SELECT ld.loan_id, ld.amount, ld.approval_date, ld.duration, ld.account_id
  FROM loan_duration ld
  WHERE DATE(ld.approval_date, '+' || (ld.duration * 30 - 1) || ' days') >= '1995-12-31'
),
account_district AS (
  SELECT al.loan_id, al.amount, al.approval_date, al.duration, a.district_id
  FROM active_loans al
  JOIN account a ON al.account_id = a.account_id
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT ad.district_id, SUM(ad.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM account_district ad
  GROUP BY ad.district_id
),
max_total AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_amount) AS max_amount FROM region_totals
)
SELECT CAST(district_id AS TEXT) AS region_name, total_amount
FROM region_totals
WHERE total_amount = (SELECT max_amount FROM max_total)
LIMIT 1000;

WITH north_bohemia_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id
  FROM account
  WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A4 = 'North Bohemia' LIMIT 1)
    AND date <= '1995-12-31'
),
ab_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id
  FROM trans
  WHERE bank = 'AB'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT nba.account_id) AS count
FROM north_bohemia_accounts nba
JOIN ab_transactions abt ON nba.account_id = abt.account_id;

WITH OwnerAccounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id
  FROM account a
  JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
), LoanCounts AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS num_loans
  FROM OwnerAccounts a
  LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(num_loans), 2) AS avg_loans_per_old_account
FROM LoanCounts;

WITH male_customers AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM client
    WHERE gender = 'M'
      AND strftime('%Y', birth_date) IN ('1974', '1975', '1976')
),
customer_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN male_customers mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
large_payments AS (
    SELECT t.trans_id, t.account_id, t.amount, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans t
    JOIN customer_accounts ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE t.amount > 4000
      AND t.type = 'payment'
),
payments_count AS (
    SELECT
      COUNT(CASE WHEN lp.k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN 1 END) AS household_payments,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN lp.k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND lp.k_symbol <> 'SIPO' THEN 1 END) AS other_purpose_payments
    FROM large_payments lp
)
SELECT household_payments, other_purpose_payments
FROM payments_count;

WITH pisek_district_payments AS (
    SELECT t.amount, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans t
    JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
    WHERE c.district_id = (
        SELECT district_id FROM district WHERE A2 = 'Pisek' LIMIT 1
    )
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
), totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(amount) AS total_outgoing,
        SUM(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS sipo_amount
    FROM pisek_district_payments
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * sipo_amount / total_outgoing, 2) AS sipo_percentage
FROM totals;

WITH litomerice_region AS (
    SELECT A5 AS region
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
accounts_1996 AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A5 AS region, a.date
    FROM account a
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE a.date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
      AND d.A5 = (SELECT region FROM litomerice_region)
),
last_balances AS (
    WITH max_trans AS (
        SELECT t.account_id, MAX(t.date) AS last_date
        FROM trans t
        WHERE t.date <= '1996-12-31'
        GROUP BY t.account_id
    ),
    max_id_per_last_date AS (
        SELECT t.account_id, t.date, MAX(t.trans_id) AS last_trans_id
        FROM trans t
        JOIN max_trans mt ON t.account_id = mt.account_id AND t.date = mt.last_date
        GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date
    )
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN max_id_per_last_date mipld ON t.account_id = mipld.account_id AND t.date = mipld.date AND t.trans_id = mipld.last_trans_id
),
account_balances_1996 AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.district_name, a.region, lb.balance
    FROM accounts_1996 a
    JOIN last_balances lb ON a.account_id = lb.account_id
),
district_stats AS (
    SELECT district_name,
           COUNT(account_id) AS accounts_opened_1996,
           ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance
    FROM account_balances_1996
    GROUP BY district_name
),
region_avg AS (
    SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_avg_balance
    FROM account_balances_1996
),
max_district AS (
    SELECT district_name
    FROM district_stats
    WHERE avg_balance = (SELECT MAX(avg_balance) FROM district_stats)
    ORDER BY district_name
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.district_name, d.accounts_opened_1996, d.avg_balance,
       r.region_avg_balance,
       m.district_name AS highest_avg_balance_district
FROM district_stats d, region_avg r, max_district m
ORDER BY d.district_name
LIMIT 1000;

WITH loans_24m AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount, a.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.duration = 24 AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
ranked_loans AS (
  SELECT loan_id, amount, district_id
  FROM loans_24m
  ORDER BY amount DESC, loan_id ASC
  LIMIT 10
),
populous_district AS (
  SELECT district_id, A9 AS inhabitants
  FROM district d
  WHERE district_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM ranked_loans)
  ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
avg_salary_across AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(A10), 2) AS avg_salary
  FROM district d
  WHERE district_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM ranked_loans)
)
SELECT pd.district_id, pd.inhabitants, asa.avg_salary
FROM populous_district pd, avg_salary_across asa;

WITH qualified_districts AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A7 AS district_name,
        d.A2 AS region,
        d.A9 AS population
    FROM district d
    WHERE d.A9 >= 100000
),

withdrawals AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM account a
    JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),

withdrawals_with_district AS (
    SELECT
        q.district_id,
        q.district_name,
        q.region,
        q.population,
        w.total_withdrawn
    FROM qualified_districts q
    JOIN withdrawals w ON w.district_id = q.district_id
),

withdrawals_per_inhabitant AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        district_name,
        region,
        population,
        total_withdrawn,
        ROUND(CAST(total_withdrawn AS FLOAT) / population, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant
    FROM withdrawals_with_district
),

ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        district_name,
        region,
        population,
        total_withdrawn,
        withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS rank
    FROM withdrawals_per_inhabitant
),

standing_order_debit_per_account AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        AVG(COALESCE(s.od_amount, 0)) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM account a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            t.account_id,
            SUM(t.amount) AS od_amount
        FROM trans t
        WHERE t.type = 'STALY_PRIKAZ'
        GROUP BY t.account_id
    ) s ON s.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)

SELECT
    rd.district_name,
    rd.region,
    rd.population,
    rd.total_withdrawn,
    rd.withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    rd.rank,
    ROUND(COALESCE(sod.avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 0), 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM ranked_districts rd
LEFT JOIN standing_order_debit_per_account sod ON sod.district_id = rd.district_id
ORDER BY rd.rank ASC;

WITH weekly_accounts AS (
    SELECT account_id, district_id
    FROM account
    WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
filtered_loans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, l.account_id, l.amount, l.date AS approved_date
    FROM loan l
    JOIN weekly_accounts wa ON l.account_id = wa.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT f.loan_id, f.account_id, f.amount, f.approved_date, a.district_id,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY f.amount DESC, f.approved_date ASC) AS rn
    FROM filtered_loans f
    JOIN account a ON f.account_id = a.account_id
),
ten_largest_loans AS (
    SELECT loan_id, account_id, amount, approved_date, district_id
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
last_transaction AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.date, MAX(t.trans_id) AS max_trans_id
    FROM trans t
    JOIN ten_largest_loans l ON t.account_id = l.account_id AND t.date = l.approved_date
    GROUP BY t.account_id, t.date
),
last_balance AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN last_transaction lt ON t.account_id = lt.account_id AND t.trans_id = lt.max_trans_id
)

SELECT l.district_id, l.amount AS approved_amount, l.approved_date, lb.balance
FROM ten_largest_loans l
LEFT JOIN last_balance lb ON l.account_id = lb.account_id
ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.approved_date ASC;

WITH InterestCodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT k_symbol FROM trans WHERE UPPER(k_symbol) = 'UROK' LIMIT 1
),
PenaltyCodes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT k_symbol FROM trans
  WHERE k_symbol LIKE (SELECT k_symbol || '%' FROM InterestCodes)
    AND k_symbol != (SELECT k_symbol FROM InterestCodes)
),
InterestAmounts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE 
          WHEN k_symbol = (SELECT k_symbol FROM InterestCodes) THEN amount 
          WHEN k_symbol IN (SELECT k_symbol FROM PenaltyCodes) THEN -amount
          ELSE 0 END) AS net_interest
  FROM trans
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 2823)
    AND date >= '1998-01-01'
    AND date <= '1998-12-31'
    AND (k_symbol = (SELECT k_symbol FROM InterestCodes) OR k_symbol IN (SELECT k_symbol FROM PenaltyCodes))
)
SELECT net_interest FROM InterestAmounts;

WITH classic_cards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT disp.client_id
  FROM card
  JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
  WHERE card.type = 'classic'
),
account_owners AS (
  SELECT disp.client_id, disp.account_id, account.district_id
  FROM disp
  JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
  WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
clients_with_classic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ao.client_id, ao.account_id, ao.district_id
  FROM account_owners ao
  JOIN classic_cards cc ON ao.client_id = cc.client_id
),
outgoing_payments AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.amount, t.bank, t.account
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
),
dist_clients AS (
  SELECT c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_classic_clients
  FROM clients_with_classic c
  GROUP BY c.district_id
),
dist_external_acc AS (
  SELECT c.district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || '-' || t.account) AS num_external_acc
  FROM clients_with_classic c
  JOIN outgoing_payments t ON c.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.bank != (SELECT A2 FROM district WHERE district_id = c.district_id LIMIT 1)
  GROUP BY c.district_id
),
dist_payment_sums AS (
  SELECT c.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_outgoing
  FROM clients_with_classic c
  JOIN outgoing_payments t ON c.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.bank != (SELECT A2 FROM district WHERE district_id = c.district_id LIMIT 1)
  GROUP BY c.district_id
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(dc.num_classic_clients, 0) AS num_classic_clients,
       COALESCE(de.num_external_acc, 0) AS num_external_accounts,
       COALESCE(dp.total_outgoing, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM district d
LEFT JOIN dist_clients dc ON d.district_id = dc.district_id
LEFT JOIN dist_external_acc de ON d.district_id = de.district_id
LEFT JOIN dist_payment_sums dp ON d.district_id = dp.district_id
ORDER BY total_outgoing_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

WITH female_clients_before_1930 AS (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM client
  WHERE gender = 'F' AND birth_date < '1930-01-01'
),
accounts_of_females AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id
  FROM disp
  WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM female_clients_before_1930)
),
districts_of_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM accounts_of_females)
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(A10), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM district
WHERE district_id IN (SELECT district_id FROM districts_of_accounts);

WITH senior_female_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, d.A13 AS avg_salary
  FROM client cl
  JOIN district d ON cl.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE cl.gender = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', cl.birth_date) < '1950'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avg_salary), 2) AS avg_of_avg_salaries
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT district_id, avg_salary
  FROM senior_female_clients
) AS unique_districts;

WITH SmallHealthyLoans AS (
    SELECT l.loan_id, a.district_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.amount < 100000
      AND l.status = 'C'
),
DistrictSalaries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.district_id, d.A10 AS avgsalary
    FROM SmallHealthyLoans s
    JOIN district d ON s.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(avgsalary), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM DistrictSalaries;

WITH races_2017 AS (
  SELECT raceId, name
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017
),
races_2000 AS (
  SELECT name
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2000
),
races_2017_not_2000 AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races_2017 r
  LEFT JOIN races_2000 r2 ON r.name = r2.name
  WHERE r2.name IS NULL
),
pitstops_per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId, COUNT(*) AS pit_stop_count
  FROM pitStops
  WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM races_2017_not_2000)
  GROUP BY raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS avg_pit_stops
FROM pitstops_per_race
;

WITH GermanDrivers AS (
  SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob, url
  FROM drivers
  WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
),
Q3Counts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS Q3Count
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url AS wikipedia_link, d.dob AS dateOfBirth, COALESCE(qc.Q3Count, 0) AS Q3Count
FROM GermanDrivers d
LEFT JOIN Q3Counts qc ON d.driverId = qc.driverId
ORDER BY Q3Count DESC, d.dob ASC;

WITH race_info AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE name = 'Japanese Grand Prix' AND year = 1995
),
q1_times AS (
    SELECT driverId, q1
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM race_info) AND q1 IS NOT NULL
),
slowest_time AS (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
               CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
               CAST(SUBSTR(q1, 7, 3) AS INTEGER)) AS slowest_ms
    FROM q1_times
),
slowest_drivers AS (
    SELECT q1.driverId, q1.q1
    FROM q1_times q1
    JOIN slowest_time st ON
      (CAST(SUBSTR(q1.q1, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
       CAST(SUBSTR(q1.q1, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
       CAST(SUBSTR(q1.q1, 7, 3) AS INTEGER)) = st.slowest_ms
),
driver_info AS (
    SELECT driverId, code AS short_name, nationality, dob
    FROM drivers
)
SELECT di.short_name, di.nationality, di.dob, sd.q1 AS q1_time
FROM slowest_drivers sd
JOIN driver_info di ON sd.driverId = di.driverId;

WITH di_grassi_quals AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.position AS di_position
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE d.forename = 'Lucas' AND d.surname = 'di Grassi' AND r.year = 2010
),
all_quals AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.position
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2010
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT other.driverId) AS count_outqualified_drivers
FROM di_grassi_quals dg
JOIN all_quals other ON dg.raceId = other.raceId
WHERE dg.di_position < other.position;

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT driverId, MIN(q2) AS fastest_q2_time
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM italian_gp_2017)
  GROUP BY driverId
),
fastest_q2_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(fastest_q2_time) AS best_time
  FROM q2_times
),
fastest_drivers AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM q2_times, fastest_q2_time
  WHERE fastest_q2_time = best_time
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM drivers d
JOIN fastest_drivers fd ON d.driverId = fd.driverId;

WITH italian_gp AS (
    SELECT r.raceId
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE c.name = 'Autodromo Nazionale Monza' OR r.name LIKE '%Italian Grand Prix%'
), 
runner_ups AS (
    SELECT res.driverId
    FROM results res
    JOIN italian_gp igp ON res.raceId = igp.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 2
), 
runner_up_names AS (
    SELECT d.forename
    FROM runner_ups ru
    JOIN drivers d ON ru.driverId = d.driverId
)
SELECT forename, COUNT(*) AS runner_up_count
FROM runner_up_names
GROUP BY forename
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY runner_up_count DESC, forename ASC;

WITH winner AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, r.time, r.raceId
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  WHERE ra.year = 2017 AND ra.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND r.positionOrder = 1
), race_info AS (
  SELECT circuitId, time as race_start_time, raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
), winner_info AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, w.time, ri.circuitId, ri.race_start_time
  FROM winner w
  JOIN drivers d ON w.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN race_info ri ON w.raceId = ri.raceId
), circuit_timezone AS (
  SELECT circuitId, local_timezone
  FROM circuits
)
SELECT 
  w.forename, 
  w.surname, 
  w.time AS finish_duration, 
  w.url,
  w.race_start_time,
  ct.local_timezone
FROM winner_info w
LEFT JOIN circuit_timezone ct ON w.circuitId = ct.circuitId;

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
drivers_in_q2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverId FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 igp ON q.raceId = igp.raceId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL AND q.q2 <> ''
),
drivers_in_q3 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT driverId FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 igp ON q.raceId = igp.raceId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL AND q.q3 <> ''
),
drivers_out_after_q2 AS (
  SELECT driverId FROM drivers_in_q2
  WHERE driverId NOT IN (SELECT driverId FROM drivers_in_q3)
)
SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM drivers d
JOIN drivers_out_after_q2 dq2 ON d.driverId = dq2.driverId
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH italian_2017_race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name LIKE '%Italian Grand Prix%'
),
q2_times AS (
  SELECT qualifying.position, qualifying.driverId, qualifying.q2
  FROM qualifying
  JOIN italian_2017_race ON qualifying.raceId = italian_2017_race.raceId
  WHERE qualifying.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
second_fastest_q2_time AS (
  SELECT q2
  FROM q2_times
  GROUP BY q2
  ORDER BY q2 ASC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)
SELECT DISTINCT drivers.nationality
FROM q2_times
JOIN drivers ON q2_times.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN second_fastest_q2_time ON q2_times.q2 = second_fastest_q2_time.q2;

WITH longest_pit_duration AS (
    SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS max_duration
    FROM pitStops
), longest_pit_stops AS (
    SELECT raceId, driverId, milliseconds
    FROM pitStops
