    WHERE milliseconds = (SELECT max_duration FROM longest_pit_duration)
), race_info AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.circuitId, r.year
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM longest_pit_stops)
), circuit_info AS (
    SELECT c.circuitId, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location, c.country
    FROM circuits c
    WHERE c.circuitId IN (SELECT circuitId FROM race_info)
)
SELECT ci.circuit_name, ci.location, ci.country, ri.year AS season_year, lps.milliseconds AS pit_stop_length
FROM longest_pit_stops lps
JOIN race_info ri ON lps.raceId = ri.raceId
JOIN circuit_info ci ON ri.circuitId = ci.circuitId;

WITH Q3_laptimes AS (
  SELECT q.driverId
  FROM qualifying q
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
), drivers_80s AS (
  SELECT d.driverId
  FROM drivers d
  WHERE d.dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31'
), Q3_count_by_driver AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS q3_laptime_count
  FROM Q3_laptimes
  GROUP BY driverId
), all_drivers_with_counts AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, COALESCE(q.q3_laptime_count, 0) AS q3_laptime_count
  FROM drivers_80s d
  LEFT JOIN Q3_count_by_driver q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_laptime_count), 2) AS avg_q3_laptimes
FROM all_drivers_with_counts;

WITH DriverFirstNames AS (
  SELECT driverId, SUBSTR(forename, 1, INSTR(forename || ' ', ' ') - 1) AS firstName, code
  FROM drivers
),
FirstNameCounts AS (
  SELECT firstName
  FROM DriverFirstNames
  GROUP BY firstName
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) > 1
),
DriversWithSharedFirstNameNoCode AS (
  SELECT dfn.driverId
  FROM DriverFirstNames dfn
  JOIN FirstNameCounts fnc ON dfn.firstName = fnc.firstName
  WHERE dfn.code IS NULL
),
Qualifying1Under2Min AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM qualifying q
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL AND q.q1 < 120000 -- qualifying times are in milliseconds; 2 mins = 120000 ms
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_qualifying_1_under_2_min
FROM Qualifying1Under2Min q1
JOIN DriversWithSharedFirstNameNoCode dwsfn ON q1.driverId = dwsfn.driverId
LIMIT 1000

WITH RobertDrivers AS (
  SELECT driverId, driverRef
  FROM drivers
  WHERE forename = 'Robert'
), 
RobertLapRaces AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lt.driverId, lt.raceId
  FROM lapTimes lt
  JOIN RobertDrivers rd ON lt.driverId = rd.driverId
),
RobertPoints AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, SUM(r.points) AS total_points
  FROM results r
  JOIN RobertLapRaces rlr ON r.driverId = rlr.driverId AND r.raceId = rlr.raceId
  GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT rd.driverRef, COALESCE(rp.total_points, 0) AS total_points
FROM RobertDrivers rd
LEFT JOIN RobertPoints rp ON rd.driverId = rp.driverId;

WITH french_gp_races AS (
  SELECT raceId, date
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'French Grand Prix' AND date >= '1990-01-01'
),
fastest_laps AS (
  SELECT lt.raceId, lt.driverId, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms
  FROM lapTimes lt
  JOIN french_gp_races fg ON lt.raceId = fg.raceId
  GROUP BY lt.raceId, lt.driverId
),
laps_over_90 AS (
  SELECT fl.raceId, fl.driverId, fl.fastest_lap_ms
  FROM fastest_laps fl
  WHERE fl.fastest_lap_ms > 90000
),
lapped_drivers AS (
  SELECT l90.raceId, l90.driverId, l90.fastest_lap_ms, d.forename, d.surname
  FROM laps_over_90 l90
  JOIN drivers d ON l90.driverId = d.driverId
),
french_gp_with_drivers AS (
  SELECT fg.date, ld.forename, ld.surname, ld.fastest_lap_ms
  FROM french_gp_races fg
  LEFT JOIN lapped_drivers ld ON fg.raceId = ld.raceId
)
SELECT date,
       forename,
       surname,
       printf('%d:%06.3f', fastest_lap_ms / 60000, (fastest_lap_ms % 60000) / 1000.0) AS fastest_lap_time
FROM french_gp_with_drivers
ORDER BY date, surname, forename;

WITH ItalianQ3Times AS (
  SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q3
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian' AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
),
MinQ3 AS (
  SELECT MIN(q3) AS fastest_q3
  FROM ItalianQ3Times
)
SELECT forename, surname, q3
FROM ItalianQ3Times
WHERE q3 = (SELECT fastest_q3 FROM MinQ3);

WITH BritishYoungDrivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'British' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
),
BritishQ3QualifyingTimes AS (
    SELECT q.driverId, q.raceId, q.q3 AS q3_time
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN BritishYoungDrivers byd ON q.driverId = byd.driverId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
),
FastestQ3Time AS (
    SELECT MIN(q3_time) AS fastest_time
    FROM BritishQ3QualifyingTimes
),
FastestQualifyings AS (
    SELECT bq3.driverId, bq3.raceId, bq3.q3_time
    FROM BritishQ3QualifyingTimes bq3
    JOIN FastestQ3Time fqt ON bq3.q3_time = fqt.fastest_time
),
RaceInfo AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.name
    FROM races r
)
SELECT d.full_name, ri.name AS race_name, ri.year AS race_year, fq.q3_time
FROM FastestQualifyings fq
JOIN BritishYoungDrivers d ON fq.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN RaceInfo ri ON fq.raceId = ri.raceId;

WITH qualifying_second_fastest AS (
  SELECT
    lt.raceId,
    lt.driverId,
    MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS best_lap_time
  FROM lapTimes lt
  GROUP BY lt.raceId, lt.driverId
),
ranked_laps AS (
  SELECT
    qsf.raceId,
    qsf.driverId,
    qsf.best_lap_time,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY qsf.raceId ORDER BY qsf.best_lap_time) AS lap_rank
  FROM qualifying_second_fastest qsf
),
drivers_born_1976_or_later AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE dob >= '1976-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rl.driverId) AS count_of_drivers
FROM ranked_laps rl
JOIN drivers_born_1976_or_later d ON rl.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE rl.lap_rank = 2;

WITH winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.forename
  FROM results r
  JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE r.positionOrder = 1
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(forename) = 'peter' THEN 'Peter'
      WHEN LOWER(forename) = 'john' THEN 'John'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS driver_count
  FROM winners
  WHERE LOWER(forename) IN ('peter', 'john')
  GROUP BY name
)
SELECT
  (SELECT driver_count FROM counts WHERE name = 'Peter') AS Peter,
  (SELECT driver_count FROM counts WHERE name = 'John') AS John;

WITH Q3_times AS (
  SELECT qualifying.raceId, qualifying.driverId, qualifying.q3 AS q3_time
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE qualifying.q3 IS NOT NULL
),
Fastest_Q3 AS (
  SELECT MIN(q3_time) AS fastest_q3_time
  FROM Q3_times
),
Drivers_with_fastest_Q3 AS (
  SELECT Q3_times.driverId
  FROM Q3_times, Fastest_Q3
  WHERE Q3_times.q3_time = Fastest_Q3.fastest_q3_time
)
SELECT DISTINCT drivers.nationality
FROM drivers
JOIN Drivers_with_fastest_Q3 ON drivers.driverId = Drivers_with_fastest_Q3.driverId;

WITH fastest_lap_constructors AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT constructorId
    FROM results
    WHERE fastestLap = 1
),
constructor_nationalities AS (
    SELECT nationality, constructorId
    FROM constructors
),
fastest_lap_counts AS (
    SELECT c.nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT f.constructorId) AS count_fastest_lap
    FROM constructor_nationalities c
    LEFT JOIN fastest_lap_constructors f ON c.constructorId = f.constructorId
    GROUP BY c.nationality
)
SELECT nationality, count_fastest_lap
FROM fastest_lap_counts
ORDER BY nationality;

WITH AustralianDrivers AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE nationality = 'Australian'
),
AustralianTopRaces AS (
  SELECT r.year, ds.raceId
  FROM races r
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
    AND ds.driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM AustralianDrivers)
    AND ds.position < 20
  GROUP BY r.year, ds.raceId
)
SELECT r.year AS season, COUNT(ps.stop) AS total_pit_stops
FROM races r
JOIN pitStops ps ON r.raceId = ps.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
  AND r.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM AustralianTopRaces)
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

WITH qualifying_1995 AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 1995
    AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
),
qualifying_1995_seconds AS (
  SELECT driverId,
         CAST(substr(q1, 1, instr(q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
         CAST(substr(q1, instr(q1, ':') + 1) AS FLOAT) AS q1_seconds
  FROM qualifying_1995
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS num_drivers_above_2_minutes
FROM qualifying_1995_seconds
WHERE q1_seconds > 120;

WITH september_2016_races AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, r.circuitId
    FROM races r
    JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
    WHERE r.year = 2016
      AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09'
),
fastest_pit_time AS (
    SELECT p.raceId, p.driverId, p.stop, MIN(p.duration) AS fastest_duration
    FROM pitStops p
    WHERE p.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM september_2016_races)
    GROUP BY p.raceId
),
fastest_pit_stops AS (
    SELECT p.*
    FROM pitStops p
    JOIN fastest_pit_time fpt ON p.raceId = fpt.raceId AND p.driverId = fpt.driverId AND p.stop = fpt.stop AND p.duration = fpt.fastest_duration
    WHERE p.raceId IN (SELECT raceId FROM september_2016_races)
),
overall_fastest_duration AS (
    SELECT MIN(fps.duration) AS min_duration
    FROM fastest_pit_stops fps
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_fullname,
       fps.duration AS pit_stop_time,
       r.name AS race_name,
       c.name AS circuit_name,
       c.location AS circuit_location
FROM fastest_pit_stops fps
JOIN drivers d ON fps.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON fps.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
CROSS JOIN overall_fastest_duration ofd
WHERE fps.duration = ofd.min_duration;

WITH WinningDrivers AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, d.dob
    FROM results r
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE r.positionOrder = 1
    GROUP BY r.driverId
),
OldestWinningDriver AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, nationality, dob
    FROM WinningDrivers
    ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
DriverFirstWin AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, ra.name AS raceName, ra.date AS raceDate
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    WHERE r.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM OldestWinningDriver) AND r.positionOrder = 1
    ORDER BY ra.date ASC, ra.name ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
DriverCareerStarts AS (
    SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS totalStarts
    FROM results
    WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM OldestWinningDriver)
    GROUP BY driverId
)

SELECT o.forename || ' ' || o.surname AS fullName,
       o.nationality,
       f.raceName,
       f.raceDate,
       c.totalStarts
FROM OldestWinningDriver o
JOIN DriverFirstWin f ON o.driverId = f.driverId
JOIN DriverCareerStarts c ON o.driverId = c.driverId
LIMIT 1;

WITH accident_statuses AS (
  SELECT statusId
  FROM status
  WHERE status LIKE '%accident%'
    AND status NOT LIKE '%killed%'
),
running_accidents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.raceId
  FROM results r
  JOIN accident_statuses a ON r.statusId = a.statusId
  JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_runnings_with_accident
FROM running_accidents;

WITH q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    q.driverId,
    q.q2 AS q2_time,
    res.grid
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId AND res.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2017 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_q2 AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    q2_time,
    grid,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY q2_time ASC, grid ASC) AS q2_rank
  FROM q2_times
)

SELECT 
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  c.name AS constructor_name
FROM ranked_q2 rq
JOIN drivers d ON rq.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructors c ON res.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN races ra ON res.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE rq.q2_rank = 2
  AND ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2017
LIMIT 1;

WITH q2_times_2017 AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.raceId, q.q2
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN seasons s ON r.year = s.year
  WHERE s.year = 2017 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
fastest_q2 AS (
  SELECT MIN(q2) AS fastest_time
  FROM q2_times_2017
),
fastest_q2_drivers AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.raceId, q.q2
  FROM q2_times_2017 q
  JOIN fastest_q2 f ON q.q2 = f.fastest_time
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.surname AS driver_surname, r.name AS race_name
FROM fastest_q2_drivers f
JOIN drivers d ON f.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON f.raceId = r.raceId;

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2017
  LIMIT 1
), q3_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q3
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 g ON q.raceId = g.raceId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
), fastest_time AS (
  SELECT MIN(CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 1, 2) AS FLOAT)*60 + CAST(SUBSTR(q3, 4) AS FLOAT)) AS fastest_seconds
  FROM q3_times
  WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL
), fastest_drivers AS (
  SELECT qt.driverId
  FROM q3_times qt
  JOIN fastest_time ft ON 
    (CAST(SUBSTR(qt.q3, 1, 2) AS FLOAT)*60 + CAST(SUBSTR(qt.q3, 4) AS FLOAT)) = ft.fastest_seconds
)
SELECT d.number
FROM drivers d
JOIN fastest_drivers fd ON d.driverId = fd.driverId
ORDER BY d.number;

WITH q3_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q3 AS q3_time
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 2017 AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
), 
max_q3_time AS (
  SELECT MAX(q3_time) AS max_time
  FROM q3_times
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM q3_times qt
JOIN max_q3_time m ON qt.q3_time = m.max_time
JOIN drivers d ON qt.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH SelectedRace AS (
  SELECT raceId, year 
  FROM races 
  WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time = '06:00:00'
  ORDER BY year DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  s.year AS season_year,
  r.time AS runner_up_time_gap
FROM 
  SelectedRace s
JOIN results r ON r.raceId = s.raceId
WHERE r.positionOrder = 2;

WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2017 AND name LIKE '%Italian Grand Prix%'
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId

ORDER BY d.code ASC;

WITH canadian_gp_races AS (

  FROM races

), winners AS (

  JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId

)
SELECT year, forename, surname, finish_time
FROM winners
ORDER BY year;

WITH race_info AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name LIKE '%Italian Grand Prix%' AND circuitId IN (
    SELECT circuitId FROM circuits WHERE name LIKE '%Monza%'
  )
), 
q3_times AS (
  SELECT pq.driverId, pq.q3
  FROM qualifying pq
  JOIN race_info ri ON pq.raceId = ri.raceId
  WHERE pq.q3 IS NOT NULL
), 
drivers_info AS (
  SELECT driverId, number, surname
  FROM drivers
)

SELECT di.number AS permanentNumber, di.surname
FROM q3_times qt
JOIN drivers_info di ON qt.driverId = di.driverId
WHERE qt.q3 < '01:38.000'
;

WITH RaceStartTimes AS (
  SELECT
    r.raceId,
    r.circuitId,
    c.circuitRef,
    r.time,
    CAST(strftime('%H', r.time) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(strftime('%M', r.time) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(strftime('%S', r.time) AS INTEGER) AS seconds_from_midnight
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
EarliestStart AS (
  SELECT MIN(seconds_from_midnight) AS earliest_time
  FROM RaceStartTimes
),
LatestStart AS (
  SELECT MAX(seconds_from_midnight) AS latest_time
  FROM RaceStartTimes
),
EarliestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuitRef
  FROM RaceStartTimes, EarliestStart
  WHERE seconds_from_midnight = earliest_time
),
LatestCircuits AS (
  SELECT circuitRef
  FROM RaceStartTimes, LatestStart
  WHERE seconds_from_midnight = latest_time
),
Gap AS (
  SELECT (latest_time - earliest_time) AS gap_seconds
  FROM EarliestStart, LatestStart
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') FROM EarliestCircuits) AS earliest_circuits,
  (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') FROM LatestCircuits) AS latest_circuits,
  (SELECT gap_seconds FROM Gap) AS gap_seconds
;

WITH italian_gp AS (
  SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
first_qualifying_names AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, d.driverRef, q.Q1
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE q.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM italian_gp)
    AND q.Q1 IS NOT NULL
),
second_qualifying_drivers AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM italian_gp)
    AND Q2 IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT fqn.driverRef
FROM first_qualifying_names fqn
LEFT JOIN second_qualifying_drivers sqd ON fqn.driverId = sqd.driverId
WHERE sqd.driverId IS NULL
ORDER BY fqn.Q1 DESC, fqn.driverId ASC;

WITH target_race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'British Grand Prix' AND year = 1962
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrew_drivers_count
FROM results res
JOIN status st ON res.statusId = st.statusId
WHERE res.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM target_race) AND st.status = 'Withdrew';

WITH RaceInfo AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 1957 AND name = 'British Grand Prix'
), RaceResults AS (
    SELECT statusId
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM RaceInfo)
), StatusCodes AS (
    SELECT statusId
    FROM status
    WHERE status NOT LIKE '%Retired%'
      AND status NOT LIKE '%Accident%'
      AND status NOT LIKE '%Disqualified%'
      AND status NOT LIKE '%Excluded%'
      AND status NOT LIKE '%Not classified%'
), ClassifiedFinishers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_classified
    FROM RaceResults
    WHERE statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM StatusCodes)
), TotalDrivers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_drivers
    FROM RaceResults
)
SELECT ROUND((CAST(num_classified AS FLOAT) / total_drivers)*100, 2) AS percentage_classified_finishers
FROM ClassifiedFinishers, TotalDrivers;

WITH womens_soccer_attendance AS (
  SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS num_attendees
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
), fall_2019_events AS (
  SELECT e.event_id
  FROM event e
  WHERE e.event_date BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-11-30'
), fall_2019_attendance AS (
  SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendance_count
  FROM fall_2019_events e
  LEFT JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
  GROUP BY e.event_id
), avg_fall_2019_attendance AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendance_count), 1) AS avg_attendance
  FROM fall_2019_attendance
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT num_attendees FROM womens_soccer_attendance) AS womens_soccer_attendees,
  (SELECT avg_attendance FROM avg_fall_2019_attendance) AS avg_fall_2019_attendance,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT num_attendees FROM womens_soccer_attendance) > (SELECT avg_attendance FROM avg_fall_2019_attendance) THEN 'more'
    WHEN (SELECT num_attendees FROM womens_soccer_attendance) < (SELECT avg_attendance FROM avg_fall_2019_attendance) THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
LIMIT 1000

WITH CollegeDepartments AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department
  FROM major
  WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
DepartmentMajors AS (
  SELECT department, GROUP_CONCAT(major_name, ', ') AS offered_majors
  FROM major
  WHERE department IN (SELECT department FROM CollegeDepartments)
  GROUP BY department
),
MemberMajors AS (
  SELECT m.department, GROUP_CONCAT(m.major_name) AS held_majors
  FROM member mb
  JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
  WHERE m.department IN (SELECT department FROM CollegeDepartments)
  GROUP BY m.department
),
MembersPerMajor AS (
  SELECT m.department, m.major_name, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member mb
  JOIN major m ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
  WHERE m.department IN (SELECT department FROM CollegeDepartments)
  GROUP BY m.department, m.major_name
),
AvgMembersPerMajor AS (
  SELECT department, ROUND(AVG(member_count), 2) AS avg_members
  FROM MembersPerMajor
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT dm.department,
       dm.offered_majors,
       COALESCE(REPLACE(mm.held_majors, ',', ', '), '') AS held_majors,
       COALESCE(am.avg_members, 0) AS avg_members_per_major
FROM DepartmentMajors dm
LEFT JOIN MemberMajors mm ON dm.department = mm.department
LEFT JOIN AvgMembersPerMajor am ON dm.department = am.department
ORDER BY dm.department;

WITH ExpenseOver50 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member, link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
),
MemberBudgetRemaining AS (
    SELECT e.link_to_member AS member_id, SUM(b.remaining) AS total_remaining
    FROM ExpenseOver50 e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY e.link_to_member
)
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, ROUND(mbr.total_remaining, 2) AS total_amount_left
FROM MemberBudgetRemaining mbr
JOIN member m ON mbr.member_id = m.member_id
ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC;

WITH Football_Attendees AS (
  SELECT link_to_member
  FROM attendance
  WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM event WHERE event_name LIKE '%Football%')
),
Dues_Payments AS (
  SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS total_dues
  FROM income
  WHERE source = 'Dues'
  GROUP BY link_to_member
)
SELECT SUM(d.total_dues) AS total_membership_dues_from_football_attendees
FROM Dues_Payments d
JOIN Football_Attendees f ON d.link_to_member = f.link_to_member;

WITH tyler_major_college AS (
  SELECT ma.college, ma.major_name
  FROM member me
  JOIN major ma ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id
  WHERE me.first_name = 'Tyler' AND me.last_name = 'Hewitt'
  LIMIT 1
),
members_per_major AS (
  SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count
  FROM member
  GROUP BY link_to_major
)
SELECT ma.major_name, COALESCE(mp.member_count, 0) AS enrolled_members
FROM major ma
JOIN tyler_major_college tmc ON ma.college = tmc.college
LEFT JOIN members_per_major mp ON ma.major_id = mp.link_to_major
WHERE COALESCE(mp.member_count, 0) = 0
ORDER BY ma.major_name;

WITH events_with_ad_budget AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE category = 'advertising'
), attendance_per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendees
    FROM attendance
    WHERE link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM events_with_ad_budget)
    GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendees), 2) AS avg_attendees
FROM attendance_per_event;

WITH budget_events AS (
  SELECT event_id, event_name, location
  FROM event
  WHERE type = 'Budget'
), attendance_counts AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
)
SELECT b.event_name, b.location, COALESCE(a.attendee_count, 0) AS attendee_count
FROM budget_events b
LEFT JOIN attendance_counts a ON b.event_id = a.link_to_event;

WITH football_attendees AS (
  SELECT attendance.link_to_member AS member_id
  FROM attendance
  JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
  WHERE event.event_name = 'Football game'
), major_counts AS (
  SELECT major.major_name, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
  FROM football_attendees
  JOIN member ON football_attendees.member_id = member.member_id
  JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
  GROUP BY major.major_name
), max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(attendee_count) AS max_attendee_count
  FROM major_counts
)
SELECT major_name, attendee_count
FROM major_counts
WHERE attendee_count = (SELECT max_attendee_count FROM max_count)
ORDER BY major_name ASC;

WITH major_coverage AS (
  SELECT
    m.major_id,
    CASE WHEN mem.member_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS has_member
  FROM major m
  LEFT JOIN member mem ON m.major_id = mem.link_to_major
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_member = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percent_no_member_majors
FROM major_coverage;

WITH event_attendance AS (
  SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, COUNT(*) AS attendee_count
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water_expenses AS (
  SELECT budget.link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(expense.cost) AS total_water_spent
  FROM expense
  JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
  WHERE expense.expense_description LIKE '%water%'
  GROUP BY budget.link_to_event
)
SELECT
  event.event_name,
  ROUND(COALESCE(total_water_spent, 0.0) / attendee_count, 2) AS amount_spent_per_attendee
FROM event
JOIN event_attendance ON event.event_id = event_attendance.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_expenses ON event.event_id = water_expenses.event_id
ORDER BY event.event_id;

WITH college_departments AS (
    SELECT major_id
    FROM major
    WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
), member_major_college AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, 
           CASE WHEN m.link_to_major IN (SELECT major_id FROM college_departments) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS in_college

WITH vp_expenses AS (

WITH event_categories AS (

), attendance_counts AS (

SELECT ec.type AS event_type, COALESCE(ac.attendee_count, 0) AS attendee_count

WITH college_counts AS (
    SELECT ma.college, COUNT(*) AS maj_count
    FROM member me
    JOIN major ma ON me.link_to_major = ma.major_id
    GROUP BY ma.college
), max_count AS (

SELECT college, maj_count

WITH pizza_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id
  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
  JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget

)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.amount), 0) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget b
WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM pizza_events);

WITH event_attendance AS (
  SELECT e.type AS event_type, a.link_to_member AS member_id
  FROM event e
  JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND e.event_date <= '2020-05-31'
),
attendance_count AS (
  SELECT event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS member_count
  FROM event_attendance

max_count AS (

SELECT e.expense_description AS item, COUNT(*) AS purchase_count
FROM expense e

WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'

ORDER BY purchase_count DESC;

WITH Purchases AS (

    e.link_to_member AS member_id,
    e.expense_description AS item,
    e.cost
  FROM expense e

Summary AS (

    member_id,

MaxDistinct AS (

SELECT

FROM Summary s

ORDER BY full_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major.major_name) AS distinct_fields_of_study
FROM member

WHERE major.department = 'Political Science Department'

WITH heroes_with_super_strength AS (
  SELECT h.id

  JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

),
powers_held_by_strength_heroes AS (

),
powers_held_by_non_strength_heroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id

  WHERE hp.hero_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM heroes_with_super_strength)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM powers_held_by_strength_heroes
WHERE power_id NOT IN (SELECT power_id FROM powers_held_by_non_strength_heroes);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS neutral_heroes_count
FROM superhero s

WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad')

WITH Blue_Haired_Heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.gender_id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
  WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
),
Hero_Power_Count AS (
  SELECT hp.hero_id, COUNT(*) AS power_count
  FROM hero_power hp

),
Blue_Hair_Hero_Powers AS (

Gender_Names AS (

WITH hulk_strength AS (
  SELECT ha.attribute_value AS hulk_strength_value
  FROM superhero s

  JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id

), heroes_with_hulk_strength AS (

)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM heroes_with_hulk_strength;

WITH RankedHeroes AS (
  SELECT id, height_cm,

  FROM superhero
),
TopTenOrTied AS (
  SELECT id

),
SuperpowersOfTop AS (

SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_superpowers

WITH A_Bomb_Publisher AS (

),
Publisher_Characters AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS no_race_count

WITH CryokinesisHolders AS (

),
SharedHeroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id

HeroPowerCounts AS (

)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS avg_power_count

WITH a_bomb_race AS (
    SELECT race_id

), group_heroes AS (
    SELECT height_cm

    WHERE race_id = (SELECT race_id FROM a_bomb_race)

)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm), 1) AS avg_height_cm
FROM group_heroes;

WITH female_hero_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.race_id
  FROM superhero h
  JOIN gender g ON h.gender_id = g.id

),
non_female_races AS (

),
valid_heroes AS (
  SELECT h.weight_kg

)
SELECT AVG(weight_kg) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM valid_heroes;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS num_publishers

WHERE s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_heroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good' AND p.publisher_name != 'DC Comics';

WITH blackwulf_publisher AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM publisher p
  JOIN superhero s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
),
blackwulf_publisher_heroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, c.colour

  WHERE s.publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM blackwulf_publisher)
),
heroes_different_publishers_eye_colours AS (

matching_eye_colours AS (

)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_hero_count
FROM matching_eye_colours;

WITH publisher_races AS (

  WHERE s.publisher_id = (

SELECT race_name, race_count

WITH FemaleHeroes AS (
  SELECT s.weight_kg

)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg FROM FemaleHeroes;

WITH green_villains AS (

)
SELECT

FROM green_villains;

WITH george_lucas_publisher AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM publisher
  WHERE publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
),
heroes_with_superpowers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.id, h.weight_kg
  FROM superhero h
  JOIN hero_power hp ON h.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE h.publisher_id IN (SELECT id FROM george_lucas_publisher)
    AND h.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM heroes_with_superpowers;

WITH HeroWeights AS (
  SELECT id, weight_kg
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
MinWeight AS (
  SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS min_weight FROM HeroWeights
),
LightestHeroes AS (

),
HeroPowerCounts AS (
  SELECT hero_power.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hero_power.power_id) AS power_count

  WHERE hero_power.hero_id IN (SELECT id FROM LightestHeroes)

),
MaxPowerCount AS (

)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_neutral_known_full_name_heroes
FROM superhero
WHERE alignment_id = (SELECT id FROM alignment WHERE alignment = 'neutral')
  AND full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(full_name) != '';

WITH BrownHairHeroes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hero.id AS hero_id
    FROM superhero hero
    JOIN colour hair ON hero.hair_colour_id = hair.id
    WHERE hair.colour = 'Brown'
),
EyeColoursInBrownHair AS (

Counts AS (

    JOIN colour hair ON hero.hair_colour_id = hair.id

)
SELECT eye_colour, non_brown_count

WITH MarvelFullNameHeroes AS (
  SELECT s.id, s.full_name, a.alignment
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL AND s.full_name != ''
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS good_percentage
FROM MarvelFullNameHeroes;

WITH MarvelGoodHeroes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id

),
MarvelHeroesWithPower AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.id
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
  JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
  WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MarvelGoodHeroes) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MarvelHeroesWithPower),
  2
) AS percent_good_marvel_heroes
;

WITH heroes_without_weight AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE weight_kg IS NULL
), eye_colour_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        col.colour AS eye_colour,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM heroes_without_weight hw
    JOIN superhero h ON h.id = hw.id
    JOIN colour col ON h.eye_colour_id = col.id
    GROUP BY col.colour
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT cnt FROM eye_colour_counts WHERE eye_colour = 'No Colour'), 0) -
    COALESCE((SELECT cnt FROM eye_colour_counts WHERE eye_colour = 'Blue'), 0) AS diff;

WITH HighUricAcidPatients AS (
  SELECT
    p.SEX,
    p.ID AS Patient_ID,
    l.UA
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID
  WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL
), FilteredPatients AS (
  SELECT
    SEX,
    Patient_ID
  FROM HighUricAcidPatients
  WHERE (SEX = 'male' AND UA > 8.0) OR (SEX = 'female' AND UA > 6.5)
  GROUP BY SEX, Patient_ID
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS female_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'male' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) /
  NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM FilteredPatients
LIMIT 1000;

WITH Eligible_Patients AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday <= DATE('2026-10-09', '-55 years')
),
Abnormal_PT_Patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Eligible_Patients p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.PT >= 14
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
    2
) AS female_percentage
FROM Abnormal_PT_Patients;

WITH PositiveCRPPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CRP LIKE '%+%'
),
NoDescriptionPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Description IS NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS DistinctPatients
FROM Patient p
JOIN PositiveCRPPatients pc ON p.ID = pc.ID
WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM NoDescriptionPatients)

WITH FemalePatients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'female'
),
NormalAntiScl70 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE SC170 = 'negative' OR SC170 = '0'
),
PatientsWithSymptoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Symptoms IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count_female_patients
FROM FemalePatients p
JOIN NormalAntiScl70 n ON p.ID = n.ID
WHERE p.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsWithSymptoms)

WITH PatientsInRange AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE substr(Birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940'
),
PatientsWithLab AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsInRange) AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
  )
),
InpatientsWithLab AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsWithLab) AND Admission = 'inpatient'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM InpatientsWithLab) / 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PatientsWithLab), 2
) AS PercentageInpatients
;

WITH
  max_rnp_result AS (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS FLOAT)) AS max_rnp
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
  ),
  strong_rnp_tests AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) = (SELECT max_rnp FROM max_rnp_result)
  ),
  max_bilirubin AS (
    SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS max_tbil
    FROM strong_rnp_tests
  ),
  final_tests AS (
    SELECT t.Date, t."T-BIL", p.ID AS PatientID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
    FROM strong_rnp_tests t
    JOIN max_bilirubin m ON t."T-BIL" = m.max_tbil
    JOIN Patient p ON t.ID = p.ID
  )
SELECT Date, "T-BIL" AS Total_Bilirubin, PatientID, SEX, Birthday
FROM final_tests
ORDER BY Date, PatientID
LIMIT 100;

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
  SELECT Patient.ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Patient.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
    AND Patient.ID IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT Examination.ID
      FROM Examination
      WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 1
    )
),

raised_rnp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Laboratory.ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE Laboratory.RNP NOT LIKE 'negative'
    AND CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS FLOAT) > 10
),

never_raised_rnp AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM thrombosis_patients
  WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM raised_rnp)
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_never_raised_rnp
FROM never_raised_rnp
LIMIT 1

WITH AbnormalSSA AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0')
), OutpatientFollowed AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = '-'
), Candidates AS (
  SELECT l.ID, CAST(l.RNP AS FLOAT) AS AntiRNP_Titer
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN AbnormalSSA a ON l.ID = a.ID
  JOIN OutpatientFollowed o ON l.ID = o.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
), MaxTiter AS (
  SELECT MAX(AntiRNP_Titer) AS MaxTiter
  FROM Candidates
)
SELECT ID, AntiRNP_Titer
FROM Candidates
WHERE AntiRNP_Titer = (SELECT MaxTiter FROM MaxTiter)
ORDER BY ID;

WITH mctd_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Diagnosis) = 1
),

platelet_normal_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
),

anti_rnp_high_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(RNP AS FLOAT) > 5
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM mctd_patients p
JOIN platelet_normal_patients pl ON p.ID = pl.ID
JOIN anti_rnp_high_patients ar ON p.ID = ar.ID
LIMIT 1000

WITH NeverExaminedPatients AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
  WHERE e.ID IS NULL
),
LabTestCounts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(DISTINCT Date) AS test_dates_count
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)

SELECT 
  p.SEX,
  ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.test_dates_count, 0)), 2) AS avg_lab_test_dates
FROM NeverExaminedPatients p
LEFT JOIN LabTestCounts l ON p.ID = l.ID
GROUP BY p.SEX
HAVING p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
ORDER BY p.SEX;
SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS FLOAT)) AS highest_anti_rnp_value FROM Laboratory WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL;

WITH DiagnosedPatients AS (
    SELECT p.ID AS patient_id
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE (
        (p.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%' AND p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%')
        AND NOT (p.Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%' AND p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%' AND LENGTH(TRIM(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.Diagnosis, 'RA', ''), 'SJS', ''))) > 0)
    )
),
PlateletResults AS (
    SELECT p.ID AS patient_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_platelet
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID
)

SELECT
    SUM(COALESCE(pr.has_normal_platelet, 0)) AS patients_with_normal_platelet,
    COUNT(dp.patient_id) - SUM(COALESCE(pr.has_normal_platelet, 0)) AS patients_without_normal_platelet
FROM DiagnosedPatients dp
LEFT JOIN PlateletResults pr ON dp.patient_id = pr.patient_id;

WITH DiagnosedPatients AS (
  SELECT ID, Birthday
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'psoriatic arthritis' AND Birthday IS NOT NULL
),
Born1960OrLater AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM DiagnosedPatients
  WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) >= '1960'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Born1960OrLater) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DiagnosedPatients), 1) AS PercentageBorn1960OrLater
;

WITH LowAlbuminPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Sex
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
)
SELECT Sex, COUNT(ID) AS patient_count
FROM LowAlbuminPatients
GROUP BY Sex;

WITH ProteinuriaPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    Patient.ID AS patient_id,
    Patient.Birthday
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE (
    (substr(Laboratory.Date, 1, 4) < '1987' AND Laboratory."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4'))

    (substr(Laboratory.Date, 1, 4) >= '1987' AND (Laboratory."U-PRO" IN ('300', '1000') OR CAST(Laboratory."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 1000))
  )
),
AgedPatients1999 AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    1999 - CAST(substr(Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS age_1999
  FROM ProteinuriaPatients
  WHERE Birthday IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(age_1999) AS average_age_1999

WITH HighMeasurements AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) > 32
)
SELECT p.SEX AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN HighMeasurements h ON p.ID = h.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX;

WITH rnp_tests AS (
  SELECT
    Patient.ID AS patient_id,
    strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS test_year,
    strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS birth_year,
    CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS INTEGER) AS rnp_titer
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND Laboratory.RNP != ''
    AND CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
),
thrombosis_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1
),
youngest_rnp_age AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(CAST(test_year AS INTEGER) - CAST(birth_year AS INTEGER)) AS youngest_age
  FROM rnp_tests
  WHERE patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM thrombosis_cohort)
)
SELECT youngest_age
FROM youngest_rnp_age
WHERE youngest_age IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 1;

WITH PsoriaticArthritisPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
),
LabCounts AS (
  SELECT ID as PatientID, COUNT(*) AS LabTestCount
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(LabTestCount), 0) FROM LabCounts WHERE PatientID IN (SELECT ID FROM PsoriaticArthritisPatients)) AS TotalLabTests,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PsoriaticArthritisPatients WHERE ID NOT IN (SELECT PatientID FROM LabCounts)) AS PatientsWithNoLabTests
;

WITH thrombosis_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
  WHERE Examination."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    AND Examination.Thrombosis > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_of_thrombosis_patients
FROM thrombosis_cohort;

WITH SLE_patients AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
Thrombotic_episodes AS (
  SELECT E.Symptoms AS symptom
  FROM Examination E
  JOIN SLE_patients S ON E.ID = S.patient_id
  WHERE E.Thrombosis = 1
),
Symptom_counts AS (
  SELECT symptom, COUNT(*) AS freq
  FROM Thrombotic_episodes
  GROUP BY symptom
)
SELECT symptom
FROM Symptom_counts
WHERE freq = (SELECT MAX(freq) FROM Symptom_counts)
ORDER BY symptom

WITH NormalASTTests AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
  FROM Laboratory
  JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.GOT < 60
  AND Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '1994-12-31'
)
SELECT SEX, COUNT(ID) AS patient_count
FROM NormalASTTests
WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY SEX;

WITH RA_Examination AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%RA%'
),
UN_Normal AS (
  SELECT ID, UN
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE UN < 30
),
RA_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ID AS Patient_ID
  FROM RA_Examination e
),
Normal_UN_Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID AS Patient_ID
  FROM UN_Normal l
),
Qualified_Patients AS (
  SELECT Patient_ID
  FROM RA_Patients
  INTERSECT
  SELECT Patient_ID
  FROM Normal_UN_Patients
),
Sex_Counts AS (
  SELECT Patient.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS count
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Qualified_Patients ON Patient.ID = Qualified_Patients.Patient_ID
  GROUP BY Patient.SEX
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE((SELECT count FROM Sex_Counts WHERE SEX = 'F'), 0) - COALESCE((SELECT count FROM Sex_Counts WHERE SEX = 'M'), 0) AS difference
;

WITH PatientsWithHighCreatinine AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 AND p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
),
TotalPatients AS (
    SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
    GROUP BY SEX
),
HighCreatininePatients AS (
    SELECT SEX, COUNT(*) AS high_count
    FROM PatientsWithHighCreatinine
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT 
    t.SEX,
    COALESCE(h.high_count, 0) AS patients_with_high_creatinine,
    t.total AS total_patients,
    ROUND(COALESCE(h.high_count, 0) * 100.0 / t.total, 1) AS share_percentage
FROM TotalPatients t
LEFT JOIN HighCreatininePatients h ON t.SEX = h.SEX
ORDER BY t.SEX;

WITH GroupMaxTcho AS (
    SELECT
        Admission AS admission_status,
        MAX([T-CHO]) AS max_t_cho
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
    WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
    GROUP BY Admission
),
MaxTchoPatients AS (
    SELECT
        Patient.ID AS patient_id,
        Admission AS admission_status,
        [T-CHO] AS t_cho
    FROM Patient
    JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
    JOIN GroupMaxTcho
    ON Patient.Admission = GroupMaxTcho.admission_status
    AND Laboratory.[T-CHO] = GroupMaxTcho.max_t_cho
)
SELECT
    patient_id,
    admission_status,
    t_cho
FROM MaxTchoPatients
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN admission_status = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  patient_id
;

WITH FirstVisitPatients AS (
    SELECT ID AS PatientID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE strftime('%Y', "First Date") = '1991'
), 
AntiRNPLevels AS (
    SELECT l.PatientID, CAST(l.RNP AS FLOAT) AS RNPLevel
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN FirstVisitPatients p ON l.PatientID = p.PatientID
    WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT PatientID, RNPLevel
FROM AntiRNPLevels
WHERE RNPLevel = (SELECT MAX(RNPLevel) FROM AntiRNPLevels);

WITH SLE_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Diagnosis) = 1
),

High_proteinuria_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND CAST("U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
    GROUP BY ID
),

SLE_only_high_proteinuria AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM SLE_patients
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ID
    FROM High_proteinuria_patients
),

Patient_care_setting AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID, Admission
    FROM Patient
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM SLE_only_high_proteinuria)
)

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'hospital' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hospitalized_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'outpatient clinic' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_clinic_count
FROM Patient_care_setting;

WITH AbnormalAntiSSA AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0', '0.0', 'zero', 'NEGATIVE')
  GROUP BY ID
), PositiveProteinuria AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" NOT IN ('negative', 'none', 'NEGATIVE', 'NONE')
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM AbnormalAntiSSA a
JOIN PositiveProteinuria p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient pa
JOIN Laboratory lb ON pa.ID = lb.ID
WHERE pa.SEX = 'female'
  AND lb.DNA IS NOT NULL
  AND CAST(lb.DNA AS INTEGER) < 8;

WITH admitted_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = '+'
),
high_alk_ph AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE ALP >= 300
),
never_high_alk_ph AS (
  SELECT patient_id
  FROM admitted_patients
  WHERE patient_id NOT IN (SELECT patient_id FROM high_alk_ph)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_never_high_alkaliphosphatase
FROM never_high_alk_ph;

WITH NormalCreatininePatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE CRE < 1.5
  )
),
AntiRNPLevels AS (
  SELECT CAST(RNP AS REAL) AS anti_rnp_level
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND RNP != ''
    AND ID IN (SELECT ID FROM NormalCreatininePatients)
)
SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_level) AS highest_anti_rnp_level
FROM AntiRNPLevels;

WITH SevereAnemiaPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient p
  JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.HGB < 7.0
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 'female'
       WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 'male'
       ELSE SEX END AS sex,
  COUNT(*) AS num_patients
FROM SevereAnemiaPatients
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX;

SELECT Laboratory.ID AS test_id, Patient.ID AS patient_id, Laboratory.Date AS test_date, Laboratory.RNP AS anti_ribonuclear_protein
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60 AND CAST(Laboratory.RNP AS INTEGER) = (
    SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS INTEGER)) 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE GOT >= 60 AND RNP IS NOT NULL
)
ORDER BY Laboratory.Date DESC;

WITH AbnormalFibrinogen AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
      AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450)
),
SevereProteinuria AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
      AND l.`U-PRO` IN ('3+', '4+')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS eligibility_count
FROM (
    SELECT ID FROM AbnormalFibrinogen
    UNION
    SELECT ID FROM SevereProteinuria
);

WITH PatientsNoSex AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX IS NULL
),
LabsForNoSexPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN PatientsNoSex pns ON l.PatientID = pns.ID
),
ElevatedTbilLabs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PatientID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN PatientsNoSex pns ON l.PatientID = pns.ID
  WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LabsForNoSexPatients) AS PatientsWithAtLeastOneLabResult,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ElevatedTbilLabs) AS PatientsWithElevatedTotalBilirubin
;

WITH FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT ID, substr(Birthday, 1, 4) AS birth_year
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'F' AND substr(Birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1945' AND '1989'
),
AdmittedPatients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission LIKE '+%'
),
ANA_P_Exclusive_IDs AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE "ANA Pattern" = 'P'
  AND INSTR("ANA Pattern", ',') = 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fp.ID) AS count_admitted_female_p_pattern
FROM FemalePatients fp
JOIN AdmittedPatients ap ON fp.ID = ap.ID
JOIN ANA_P_Exclusive_IDs apatt ON fp.ID = apatt.ID
;

WITH OutpatientPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS Patient_ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission <> 'inpatient'
),
HemoglobinBelow10Patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID AS Patient_ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB < 10
),
PatientsOfInterest AS (
  SELECT Patient_ID
  FROM OutpatientPatients
  WHERE Patient_ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM HemoglobinBelow10Patients)
),
MaxAntiRNP AS (
  SELECT ID AS Patient_ID, MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS Max_Anti_RNP
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT Patient_ID FROM PatientsOfInterest)
  GROUP BY ID
),
MaxOverall AS (
  SELECT MAX(Max_Anti_RNP) AS Highest_Level
  FROM MaxAntiRNP
)
SELECT m.Patient_ID, pat.SEX, m.Max_Anti_RNP
FROM MaxAntiRNP m
JOIN MaxOverall mo ON m.Max_Anti_RNP = mo.Highest_Level
JOIN Patient pat ON m.Patient_ID = pat.ID
ORDER BY m.Patient_ID;

WITH FirstLab AS (
  SELECT ID, MIN(Date) AS first_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_patients
FROM FirstLab FL
JOIN Laboratory L ON FL.ID = L.ID AND FL.first_date = L.Date
JOIN Patient P ON FL.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.GOT < 60
AND CAST(L.RNP AS INTEGER) > 10;

WITH LatestProteinuria AS (
    SELECT
        ID AS PatientID,
        MAX(Date) AS MostRecentTestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("U-PRO") <> ''
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    p.ID AS PatientID,
    p.SEX,
    lp.MostRecentTestDate,
    l."U-PRO" AS ProteinuriaLevel
FROM LatestProteinuria lp
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = lp.PatientID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = lp.PatientID AND l.Date = lp.MostRecentTestDate
WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") <> ''
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH ElevatedAntiRNP AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Patient 
    WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RNP >= '16')
),
NormalRangeGPT AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS MaxNormalGPT
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT < 60
    GROUP BY ID
),
Candidates AS (
    SELECT e.ID, n.MaxNormalGPT
    FROM ElevatedAntiRNP e
    JOIN NormalRangeGPT n ON e.ID = n.ID
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Candidates c
JOIN Patient p ON c.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY c.MaxNormalGPT DESC, p.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH filtered_lab AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lab1.ID
  FROM Laboratory lab1
  JOIN Laboratory lab2 ON lab1.ID = lab2.ID
  WHERE lab1.PT < 14
    AND CAST(lab2.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 16
    AND lab1.Date = lab2.Date
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN filtered_lab fl ON p.ID = fl.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'female'

WITH InpatientTests AS (
  SELECT
    L.ID AS Laboratory_ID,
    L.Date AS Test_Date,
    L.DNA AS Anti_DNA_Antibody_Level,
    P.ID AS Patient_ID,
    P.Birthday,
    P.Diagnosis
  FROM Laboratory L
  JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
  WHERE P.Admission = '+'
    AND L.DNA IS NOT NULL
),
MaxTest AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(Anti_DNA_Antibody_Level AS INTEGER)) AS Max_Level FROM InpatientTests
),
EarliestMax AS (
  SELECT * FROM InpatientTests
  WHERE CAST(Anti_DNA_Antibody_Level AS INTEGER) = (SELECT Max_Level FROM MaxTest)
  ORDER BY Test_Date ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  Patient_ID,
  Diagnosis,
  Anti_DNA_Antibody_Level,
  Test_Date,
  (strftime('%Y', Test_Date) - strftime('%Y', Birthday) - (strftime('%m-%d', Test_Date) < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday))) AS Age_Completed_Years
FROM EarliestMax;

WITH Confirmed_SLE_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE confirmed%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Confirmed_SLE_Patients s ON p.ID = s.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 1.2
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH FemalePatients AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
    AND date('2026-10-09') >= date(p.Birthday, '+50 years')
),
PatientCareSetting AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    CASE
      WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS care_setting
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
PatientAntiRNPStatus AS (
  SELECT
    l.ID AS lab_id,
    l.RNP AS rnp_value,
    CASE
      WHEN l.RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(l.RNP AS FLOAT) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_high,
    p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
),
HighRNPPatients AS (
  SELECT patient_id, MAX(is_high) AS has_high_anti_rnp
  FROM PatientAntiRNPStatus
  GROUP BY patient_id
),
RelevantPatients AS (
  SELECT
    fp.patient_id,
    pcs.care_setting,
    IFNULL(h.has_high_anti_rnp, 0) AS has_high_anti_rnp
  FROM FemalePatients fp
  JOIN PatientCareSetting pcs ON fp.patient_id = pcs.patient_id
  LEFT JOIN HighRNPPatients h ON fp.patient_id = h.patient_id
)
SELECT
  care_setting,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_high_anti_rnp = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_high_anti_rnp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_high_anti_rnp = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_without_high_anti_rnp
FROM RelevantPatients
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting ASC;

WITH SLE_patients AS (
  SELECT ID AS patient_id, Diagnosis
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
Anti_DNA_results AS (
  SELECT ID, DNA
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE DNA IS NOT NULL
),
Max_DNA AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(DNA AS INTEGER)) AS max_dna
  FROM Anti_DNA_results a
  JOIN SLE_patients s ON a.ID = s.patient_id
  WHERE DNA GLOB '*[0-9]*'
)

SELECT s.patient_id, s.Diagnosis, a.DNA AS highest_anti_DNA_result
FROM SLE_patients s
JOIN Anti_DNA_results a ON s.patient_id = a.ID
JOIN Max_DNA m ON CAST(a.DNA AS INTEGER) = m.max_dna
WHERE a.DNA GLOB '*[0-9]*'
LIMIT 1000

WITH LatestVisits AS (
    SELECT ID AS patient_id, MAX(Date) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
StronglyPositiveAntiRNP AS (
    SELECT l.ID AS patient_id, l.RNP, p.SEX
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN LatestVisits lv ON l.ID = lv.patient_id AND l.Date = lv.max_date
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS INTEGER) >= 32
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) -
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'male' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS female_minus_male
FROM StronglyPositiveAntiRNP
;

WITH LatestRNP AS (
  SELECT
    pat.ID AS PatientID,
    lab.ID AS LabID,
    lab.RNP AS RNP,
    lab.CPK AS CPK,
    lab.Date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pat.ID ORDER BY lab.Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Patient pat
  JOIN Laboratory lab ON pat.ID = lab.ID
  WHERE pat.SEX = 'Female'
    AND lab.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND lab.RNP != ''
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS FemalePatientsCount
FROM LatestRNP
WHERE rn = 1
  AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) > 64
  AND CPK < 250
LIMIT 1000

WITH confirmed_SLE_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
),
inpatient_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM confirmed_SLE_patients)
    AND Admission = 'inpatient'
),
outpatient_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM confirmed_SLE_patients)
    AND Admission = 'outpatient'
),
total_care_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM (
    SELECT ID FROM inpatient_patients
    UNION
    SELECT ID FROM outpatient_patients
  )
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inpatient_patients) AS inpatient_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outpatient_patients) AS outpatient_count,
  ROUND(CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inpatient_patients) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM total_care_patients) * 100, 2) AS inpatient_percentage
;

WITH LDH_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ID AS examination_id, p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.LDH >= 500
),
Urinary_protein_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.ID AS examination_id, p.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL 
    AND (
      l."U-PRO" LIKE '100' OR l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=100%' OR l."U-PRO" LIKE '%(100)%'
    )
),
Patients_with_LDH AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM LDH_patients
),
Patients_with_Protein AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM Urinary_protein_patients
)
SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Patients_with_LDH ldh ON p.ID = ldh.patient_id
JOIN Patients_with_Protein up ON p.ID = up.patient_id
ORDER BY p.ID
LIMIT 1000;

WITH patients_with_no_exams AS (
  SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
  FROM Patient
  LEFT JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
  WHERE Examination.ID IS NULL
)
SELECT SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS number_of_patients
FROM patients_with_no_exams
GROUP BY SEX;

WITH admitted_females AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Patient.SEX = 'female'
    AND Patient."First Date" BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
    AND Patient.Admission LIKE '+%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS FemaleAdmittedPatients1998
FROM admitted_females;

WITH SLE_EXAMS AS (
  SELECT e.ID AS exam_id, e."Examination Date" AS exam_date, e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis AS exam_diagnosis, p.ID AS patient_id, p.Birthday
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
),

YOUNGEST_PATIENT AS (
  SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.Birthday
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT patient_id FROM SLE_EXAMS)
  ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC, p.ID ASC
  LIMIT 1
),

RECENT_QUALIFYING_EXAM AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM SLE_EXAMS
  WHERE patient_id = (SELECT patient_id FROM YOUNGEST_PATIENT)
  ORDER BY exam_date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT r.Symptoms, p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis
FROM RECENT_QUALIFYING_EXAM r
JOIN Patient p ON r.patient_id = p.ID;

WITH FirstSeenVisits AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID AS PatientID,
        p.Birthday,
        e.Diagnosis,
        e."Examination Date" AS VisitDate,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY e."Examination Date") AS visit_rank
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = 'inpatient'
      AND e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1998-02-15' AND '1998-02-28'
),
FirstVisits AS (
    SELECT PatientID, Birthday, Diagnosis, VisitDate
    FROM FirstSeenVisits
    WHERE visit_rank = 1
    AND PatientID NOT IN (
        SELECT p.ID
        FROM Patient p
        JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
        WHERE e."Examination Date" < '1998-02-15'
    )
),
OldestPatient AS (
    SELECT PatientID, Birthday, Diagnosis
    FROM FirstVisits
    ORDER BY (julianday('1998-02-15') - julianday(Birthday)) DESC, PatientID ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT Diagnosis FROM OldestPatient
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) AS avg_anti_cardiolipin_IgM
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" BETWEEN '1993-10-01' AND '1993-10-31'
  AND Diagnosis = 'systemic lupus erythematosus'
  AND "aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL;

WITH psoriatic_arthritis_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE LOWER(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM psoriatic_arthritis_patients;

WITH PatientsWithLowRBC AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
  FROM Patient
  JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
  WHERE Laboratory.RBC < 3.5
),
PatientData AS (
  SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.Admission, 
         CAST((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(Patient.Birthday))/365.25 AS INTEGER) AS AgeOnDate
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Patient.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM PatientsWithLowRBC)
)
SELECT 
  Admission AS CareSetting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS PatientCount,
  ROUND(AVG(AgeOnDate), 1) AS AvgAge
FROM PatientData
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission DESC;

WITH SJS_Patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS'
),
SJS_Examinations AS (
  SELECT e."aCL IgM" AS aCL_IgM
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN SJS_Patients p ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e."aCL IgM" > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(aCL_IgM), 2) AS Avg_AntiCardiolipin_IgM
FROM SJS_Examinations;

WITH OutpatientPatients AS (
  SELECT ID FROM Patient
  WHERE Admission = 'no'
),
NormalRNPPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP = 'negative' OR RNP = '0'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS PatientCount
FROM OutpatientPatients
WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM NormalRNPPatients);

WITH RelevantPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lab.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory lab
  WHERE (lab.SM IN ('negative', '0'))
),
NoThrombosisPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT exam.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Examination exam
  WHERE exam.Thrombosis = 0 OR exam.Thrombosis IS NULL
),
ProteinuriaPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lab.ID AS patient_id
  FROM Laboratory lab
  WHERE lab."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', 'TR', '')
    AND CAST(lab."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) >= 30
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS num_patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN RelevantPatients r ON p.ID = r.patient_id
JOIN NoThrombosisPatients n ON p.ID = n.patient_id
JOIN ProteinuriaPatients s ON p.ID = s.patient_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH FilteredPatients AS (
  SELECT ID, Birthday
  FROM Patient
  WHERE julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(Birthday) < 70 * 365.25
),
PositiveAntiRNPPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) >= 64
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(fp.Birthday)) / 365.25), 1) AS AverageAge
FROM FilteredPatients fp
JOIN PositiveAntiRNPPatients par ON fp.ID = par.ID

WITH FilteredLabs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE 
    WBC > 3.5 AND WBC < 9.0
    AND (FG <= 150 OR FG >= 450)
    AND CAST(RNP AS INTEGER) > 15
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN FilteredLabs fl ON p.ID = fl.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'female';

WITH Patients1936to1956 AS (
  SELECT ID, SEX, STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS birth_year
  FROM Patient
  WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
),
PatientsWithHighCPK AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CPK >= 250
),
EligiblePatients AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patients1936to1956 p
  LEFT JOIN PatientsWithHighCPK h ON p.ID = h.ID
  WHERE h.ID IS NULL
),
GenderCounts AS (
  SELECT 
    SEX,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM EligiblePatients
  GROUP BY SEX
),
Totals AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT cnt FROM GenderCounts WHERE SEX = 'F') AS females,
    (SELECT cnt FROM GenderCounts WHERE SEX = 'M') AS males
)
SELECT
  ROUND(CAST(females AS FLOAT) / (females + males) * 100, 1) AS female_percentage
FROM Totals;

WITH ProteinuriaTests AS (
  SELECT l.ID AS laboratory_id, l.Date AS test_date, p.ID AS patient_id, p.Birthday, l.PLT, l."U-PRO" AS U_PRO
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.Date BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1986-12-31'
    AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
    AND ("U-PRO" != '0' AND "U-PRO" != '-' AND "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL)
), PatientsUnder50 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
  FROM ProteinuriaTests
  WHERE CAST((julianday(test_date) - julianday(Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) < 50
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
FROM PatientsUnder50;

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, 
         COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecule m
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'O'
  WHERE m.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM single_bond_molecules)
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS avg_oxygen_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_counts;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
), single_bonds_per_molecule AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-' 
  GROUP BY molecule_id
), carcinogenic_with_single_bonds AS (
  SELECT cm.molecule_id, sb.single_bond_count
  FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
  JOIN single_bonds_per_molecule sb ON cm.molecule_id = sb.molecule_id
  WHERE sb.single_bond_count >= 1
)
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds_per_carcinogenic_molecule
FROM carcinogenic_with_single_bonds;

WITH NonCarcinogenicMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '-'
),
ElementCounts AS (
    SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS total_count
    FROM atom a
    JOIN NonCarcinogenicMolecules ncm ON a.molecule_id = ncm.molecule_id
    GROUP BY a.element
),
MinCount AS (
    SELECT MIN(total_count) AS min_count
    FROM ElementCounts
)
SELECT element, total_count
FROM ElementCounts, MinCount
WHERE total_count = min_count
ORDER BY element;

WITH single_bonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
), 
atom_elements AS (
    SELECT atom_id, element
    FROM atom
)

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
   FROM atom_elements a
   JOIN single_bonds sb ON a.atom_id = sb.atom_id
   WHERE a.element = 'I') AS iodine_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id)
   FROM atom_elements a
   JOIN single_bonds sb ON a.atom_id = sb.atom_id
   WHERE a.element = 'S') AS sulfur_count
;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
molecule_fluorine AS (
  SELECT cm.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS fluorine_count
  FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON cm.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND a.element = 'F'
  GROUP BY cm.molecule_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN fluorine_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM molecule_fluorine;

WITH molecule_carci AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
), bond_types AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY bond_type
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  b.bond_type AS most_common_bond_type,
  CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM bond_types b
CROSS JOIN molecule_carci m
LIMIT 1;

WITH MoleculesWithTripleBond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '#'
), MoleculesWithPOrBr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IN ('P', 'Br')
), TargetMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM MoleculesWithTripleBond
  INTERSECT
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM MoleculesWithPOrBr
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM TargetMolecules);

WITH SingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '-'
), ChlorineAtomsInSingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element = 'Cl' AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM SingleBondMolecules)
), AllAtomsInSingleBondMolecules AS (
    SELECT atom_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM SingleBondMolecules)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ChlorineAtomsInSingleBondMolecules) AS FLOAT) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AllAtomsInSingleBondMolecules), 4) AS percentage_chlorine_atoms
;

WITH molecule_bond_info AS (
    SELECT
        m.molecule_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_non_single_bond,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
    FROM molecule m
    LEFT JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_non_single_bond = 0 THEN carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_molecules_diff,
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_non_single_bond = 1 THEN carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count ELSE 0 END) AS other_molecules_diff
FROM molecule_bond_info;

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT molecule_id
    FROM molecule
    WHERE label = '+'
), carbon_carbon_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS double_bond_count
    FROM bond b
    JOIN carcinogenic_molecules c ON b.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a1 ON b.molecule_id = a1.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON b.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
      AND a1.element = 'C'
      AND a2.element = 'C'
    GROUP BY b.molecule_id, b.bond_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(1), 0) AS total_carbon_carbon_double_bonds
FROM carbon_carbon_double_bonds;

WITH chlorine_atoms AS (SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'cl'),
bonded_atoms AS (SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms) THEN atom_id2 ELSE atom_id END AS bonded_atom
               FROM connected
               WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms) OR atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM chlorine_atoms))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bonded_atom) AS count_bonded_atoms FROM bonded_atoms;

WITH SulfurAtoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE a.element = 's' AND m.label = '+'
),
DirectBonds AS (
  SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN SulfurAtoms s ON c.atom_id = s.atom_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN SulfurAtoms s ON c.atom_id2 = s.atom_id
),
BondedAtoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM SulfurAtoms) THEN atom_id2 ELSE atom_id END AS bonded_atom_id
  FROM DirectBonds
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bonded_atom_id) AS bonded_atoms_to_sulfur_in_carcinogenic
FROM BondedAtoms;

WITH CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
ElementOccurrences AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
),
UniqueElementMolecules AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN ElementOccurrences eo ON a.element = eo.element
  WHERE eo.molecule_count = 1
),
TargetMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM CarcinogenicMolecules
  INTERSECT
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM UniqueElementMolecules
)

SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN TargetMolecules tm ON b.molecule_id = tm.molecule_id

WITH nitrogen_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'n'
),

nitrogen_bond_types AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id, b.bond_type, a.atom_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE a.element = 'n' AND (b.bond_id LIKE '%' || a.atom_id || '%' OR b.bond_id LIKE '%' || a.atom_id || '%')
),

molecule_nitrogen_bond_check AS (
  SELECT molecule_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_double_or_triple
  FROM nitrogen_bond_types
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),

molecules_with_nitrogen AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM nitrogen_atoms
)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_molecules
FROM molecules_with_nitrogen mw
JOIN molecule_nitrogen_bond_check mnbc ON mw.molecule_id = mnbc.molecule_id
WHERE mnbc.has_double_or_triple = 0;

WITH ElementOccurrence AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
), RareElements AS (
  SELECT element
  FROM ElementOccurrence
  WHERE molecule_count = 1
), CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
), RareElementAtoms AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_id, a.atom_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN RareElements re ON a.element = re.element
  WHERE a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM CarcinogenicMolecules)
), BondsWithRareAtoms AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, a.molecule_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN RareElementAtoms a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
), BondCountPerMolecule AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM BondsWithRareAtoms
  GROUP BY molecule_id
)
SELECT molecule_id, bond_count
FROM BondCountPerMolecule
ORDER BY molecule_id;

WITH atom_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_carbons,
    SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_chlorines
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    c.atom_id,
    c.atom_id2,
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2,
    b.bond_type
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN element1 = 'C' OR element2 = 'C' THEN bond_id END) AS num_carbon_touching_bonds,
    COUNT(*) AS num_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multiple_bonds
  FROM bond_atoms
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
molecules_with_c AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'C'
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds DESC, ac.num_atoms DESC, ac.molecule_id ASC) AS rank,
  ac.molecule_id,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
  ac.num_atoms,
  ac.num_carbons,
  ac.num_chlorines,
  ctb.num_carbon_touching_bonds,
  ctb.num_multiple_bonds
FROM atom_counts ac
JOIN carbon_touching_bonds ctb ON ac.molecule_id = ctb.molecule_id
JOIN molecule m ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN molecules_with_c mc ON ac.molecule_id = mc.molecule_id
ORDER BY rank
;

WITH molecule_with_yttrium AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element = 'Y'
  LIMIT 1
),
hydrogen_bonds AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_hydrogen_bonds
  FROM bond b
  JOIN molecule_with_yttrium m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  WHERE a.element = 'H'
)
SELECT count_hydrogen_bonds FROM hydrogen_bonds;

WITH non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '-'
),
carbon_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'C'
),
bonds_of_interest AS (
  SELECT c.bond_id, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN non_carcinogenic_molecules ncm ON b.molecule_id = ncm.molecule_id
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('2', '3')
),
carbon_connected AS (
  SELECT b.bond_id, b.atom_id, b.atom_id2
  FROM bonds_of_interest b
  WHERE b.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM carbon_atoms) OR b.atom_id2 IN (SELECT atom_id FROM carbon_atoms)
),
elements AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM carbon_atoms) THEN atom_id2
      ELSE atom_id
    END AS other_atom_id
  FROM carbon_connected
),
element_counts AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM elements e
  JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = e.other_atom_id
  GROUP BY a.element
)
SELECT element, count
FROM element_counts
ORDER BY element;

WITH BondInfo AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_symbol,
    c.atom_id,
    c.atom_id2
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377')
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
),
BondCounts AS (
  SELECT
    bond_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN atom_id < atom_id2 THEN atom_id || '-' || atom_id2 ELSE atom_id2 || '-' || atom_id END) AS element_pairs
  FROM BondInfo
  GROUP BY bond_symbol
),
MoleculeCarcinogenicity AS (
  SELECT label AS carcinogenicity_label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
)
SELECT
  bc.bond_symbol,
  bc.bond_count,
  bc.element_pairs,
  mc.carcinogenicity_label
FROM BondCounts bc
CROSS JOIN MoleculeCarcinogenicity mc
ORDER BY bc.bond_count DESC, bc.bond_symbol ASC;

WITH metal_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li')
), single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
), non_carcinogenic_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '-'
)

SELECT molecule_id
FROM non_carcinogenic_molecules
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM metal_atoms)
  AND molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM single_bond_molecules)
ORDER BY molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_types AS (
  SELECT
    c.atom_id,
    b.bond_type
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
),
atom_bond_summary AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element,
    SUM(CASE WHEN abt.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN abt.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM atom a
  LEFT JOIN atom_bond_types abt ON a.atom_id = abt.atom_id
  GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
  element,
  COUNT(*) AS single_bond_only_atom_count
FROM atom_bond_summary
WHERE single_bond_count > 0
  AND multiple_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH TripleBondAtoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id, molecule_id
  FROM connected c
  JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
),
ElementsInTripleBonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN TripleBondAtoms tba ON a.atom_id = tba.atom_id
),
ElementMoleculeCounts AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM ElementsInTripleBonds
  GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element AS element_symbol, molecule_count
FROM ElementMoleculeCounts
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

WITH molecule_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom.atom_id, atom.element
  FROM atom
  WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR397'
), bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id FROM connected
  UNION ALL
  SELECT atom_id2 as atom_id FROM connected
), tr397_bonded_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id
  FROM bonded_atoms
  WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM molecule_atoms)
)

SELECT ma.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM molecule_atoms ma
JOIN tr397_bonded_atoms ba ON ma.atom_id = ba.atom_id
GROUP BY ma.element
ORDER BY ma.element ASC;
